```json
{
  "content": "# Working tabs — context\n\n## Glossary\n\n- **Tab** — one stored record (`SpaceNode.type === 'tab'`) tracking one leaf by `tabKey` (file path, or `viewType:leafId` for non-file views).\n- **Pane** — an Obsidian tab container (`leaf.parent`, a `WorkspaceTabs`) in the main area. Has a runtime `id` (undocumented, same status as `leaf.id`).\n- **Group** — a stored node that *claims one pane*. States: **live** (claims an existing pane via `homePaneId`), **dormant** (claims nothing; tab list intact, reopenable), **hidden** (live, pane `display:none`), **completed** (under `__completed__`).\n- **Section** — a folder of groups representing a timeframe. May be **focused** (at most one).\n- **Merge** — moving every live tab of group H into the pane of group G; H is removed and a **MergeReceipt** is kept for Undo.\n- **Membership** — the rule deciding which group each live leaf belongs to, computed as a pure **plan** from a **WorkspaceSnapshot** (`src/membership.ts`), applied by `LeafSync`.\n\n## Architecture notes\n\n- Workspace is the source of truth for membership. Records are **moved** (`moveTabRecord`), never deleted and re-created, when a leaf appears under another live group.\n- Opening a dormant group never merges implicitly. Merge is only via **Open in current pane (merge)** or dropping on a pane's centre zone.\n- Focus: `focusedSectionId` on `TabSpacesData`; `isEffectivelyHidden` combines group hidden, section hidden, and focus.\n"
}
```

Inspired by Workona, built for Obsidian.\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"docs/demo.gif\" width=\"840\" alt=\"The Working tabs sidebar beside three Obsidian panes. Groups are browsed and their tabs focused, then checked off one at a time until a group completes itself into Completed; a new section is created, renamed, and groups are dragged into it.\">\n</p>\n\n**Colour-code your groups and sections too.** Every one is auto-assigned a colour, drawn as a stripe down its pane's left edge and a matching bar on its sidebar row — so you can tell at a glance which pane belongs where. File a group into a section and it takes on that section's colour.\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"docs/colour-coding.gif\" width=\"840\" alt=\"A colour is picked for a group from its menu, showing the palette with a swatch beside each name. A new section is then created and a group dragged into it, which immediately takes on the section's colour.\">\n</p>\n\n## Why\n\nArranging *how* open tabs render — columns, continuous scroll, and the like — is a layout problem. It doesn't solve the actual one: **you have twelve tabs open across three panes and no way to say \"these six belong together, tuck them away, and give me back my screen.\"**\n\nWorking tabs is task-and-timeframe oriented, not layout-oriented:\n\n- **Tabs-as-tasks.** A tab stays open because the work behind it isn't done. So a group of tabs is a unit of in-progress work, not just a pile of panes — closing it out is *completing* it, and completed groups sit in a recoverable Completed list instead of just vanishing.\n- **Timeframe over project.** Your notes are already organized by project or topic — that's what your vault's folders and links are for. What they don't capture is *when* something matters: this week's research, a deadline you're heads-down on, a sprint that ends Friday. Sections exist for that — a place to park related groups for as long as they're relevant, then hide the whole thing in one click once the timeframe's over, without deleting anything.\n- **Every pane is already a group.** There's no \"create a group\" step to remember. Open some tabs in a pane and Working tabs has already named it, tracked it, and listed it in the sidebar — organizing it into a section or renaming it is optional, not required up front.\n\n## In practice\n\nTwo shapes this tends to take:\n\n**Notes, by timeframe.** A section per sprint, deadline, or research push; the groups inside it are the threads of work you're actually holding open. When the timeframe ends, hide the section and the whole thing goes quiet in one click.\n\n**Terminals, by what they're doing.** If you run terminals in your vault — say with [Terminus](https://community.obsidian.md/plugins/terminus) — they pile up fast, and they aren't interchangeable. Three long-lived Claude Code sessions you're actively talking to are a different kind of thing from the throwaway shells running `npx expo run:ios` or `astro build`. Put each kind in its own pane and you already have two groups: one you keep in view, one you hide until a build fails.\n\nHiding matters here specifically because it doesn't close anything — the pane is tucked out of sight, not torn down, so every process inside it keeps running while you get the screen space back. (Completing a group *does* close its pane, which ends whatever was running in it.) Terminal tabs are tracked for as long as Obsidian stays open; unlike note tabs, they can't be reopened after a restart, since the underlying processes don't survive one either.\n\n## Features\n\n### Groups\n- Every pane of tabs in the main workspace is automatically a group — no manual creation step.\n- Hover a group for quick actions: hide the pane, mark it complete, or open its menu. Click the row to reveal its pane if it's already open, or reopen it if it's dormant.\n- **Open in...** split right, split down, new window, or new tab — matching Obsidian's own placement vocabulary. Opening into an already-occupied pane merges the two groups together.\n- Rename inline (double-click or F2) and add an optional description shown under the title.\n- **Hide a group** to tuck its pane away without closing it — the tabs stay open in the background, just out of view, and unhiding brings them right back.\n- **Colour coding** ties a pane to its place in the sidebar: every group and section is auto-assigned a colour, drawn as a stripe down the pane's left edge and a matching bar on the sidebar row. Groups follow their section's colour, so filing a group into a section adopts it — even one you'd recoloured by hand — and dragging it back out restores its own. Pick \"Colour\" on any group or section to override, \"No colour\" to opt one out, or \"Automatic\" to go back to following along. Turn the whole thing off in settings without losing the colours you picked.\n- **Closing a pane never deletes its group** — whether you use the sidebar's \"Close group\" or Obsidian's own tab-strip menu (\"Close all\", closing the last tab, closing the split), the group just goes dormant with its tab list intact, ready to reopen. Deleting it is always a deliberate choice.\n- **Complete a group** when the work is done: its pane closes, but the group and its tab list move to Completed, fully restorable later. A per-tab \"done\" checkbox lets you check off individual tabs without completing the whole group.\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <img src=\"docs/demo-sidebar.gif\" width=\"330\" alt=\"The sidebar panel. Three tabs are checked off one by one, each striking through and dropping to the bottom of its group; with all three done the group leaves the list and lands under Completed. A new section is then created, renamed, and groups are dragged into it.\">\n  <br>\n  <em>Check tabs off as you finish them — the group completes itself and moves to Completed. Sections keep what's left filed by timeframe.</em>\n</p>\n\n### Sections\n- Fold related groups together under one collapsible header — by timeframe, sprint, or whatever grouping makes sense for how you work."
```json
}
```

```
<body>
  <div class="brief">
    <h1>Working tabs wireframe</h1>
    <p>Click only selects. The tab stack docks the whole pane. A tab’s own menu sends that tab into a pool or another group. Ctrl-click several tabs, then right-click, to send them together. Right-click a sidebar row for the same send commands.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="stage">
    <div class="window">
      <aside>
        <input class="search" value="" placeholder="Search tabs and groups…" disabled />
        <div class="tree" id="tree"></div>
      </aside>
      <main>
        <div class="workspace" id="workspace"></div>
      </main>
      <div class="status" id="status">Click a tab to select it. The pane stays where it is.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="menu" class="menu hidden"></div>
<script>
const sections = [
  { id: "nav", title: "Navigation", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "work", title: "Work", color: "#e08b3c" },
];

let groups = [
  { id: "sast", title: "SAST", sectionId: "nav", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "main", title: "Main", sectionId: "nav", color: "#8b6fd6" },
  { id: "home", title: "Home", sectionId: "nav", color: "#43a047" },
  { id: "qisl", title: "QISL Platform", sectionId: "work", color: "#e08b3c", dock: "main" },
  { id: "harness", title: "Tool Harness", sectionId: "work", color: "#2fa3a3" },
  { id: "sfa", title: "SFA", sectionId: "work", color: "#4a7fe0" },
  { id: "pay", title: "Payment Gateway", sectionId: "work", color: "#d0a215" },
  { id: "ext", title: "External Services", sectionId: "work", color: "#d1453b" },
];

let tabs = [
  { id: "a", title: "Architecture and Design of a Decoupled…", groupId: "qisl", order: 0 },
  { id: "b", title: "Session Recovery — Backend Gr…", groupId: "qisl", order: 1 },
  { id: "c", title: "Belial Dreams", groupId: "qisl", order: 2 },
  { id: "d", title: "Terminus 1", groupId: "qisl", order: 3 },
  { id: "e", title: "QISL Platform", groupId: "qisl", order: 4 },
  { id: "f", title: "Payment notes", groupId: "ext", order: 0 },
  { id: "g", title: "Theme registry", groupId: "harness", order: 0 },
];

let activeId = "e";
let selected = new Set(["e"]);
let sideSelected = null;
let seq = 1;

const tree = document.getElementById("tree");
const workspace = document.getElementById("workspace");
const status = document.getElementById("status");
const menu = document.getElementById("menu");

function groupById(id) { return groups.find((g) => g.id === id); }
function sectionById(id) { return sections.find((s) => s.id === id); }
function tabById(id) { return tabs.find((t) => t.id === id); }

function say(text) { status.textContent = text; }

function tabsInGroup(groupId) {
  return tabs
    .filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId && !t.poolSectionId)
    .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

function poolTabs(sectionId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.poolSectionId === sectionId);
}

function visibleGroups() {
  return groups.filter((g) => g.dock);
}

function render() {
  renderTree();
  renderWorkspace();
}

function renderTree() {
  tree.replaceChildren();
  for (const section of sections) {
    const label = el("div", "sec-label");
    label.append(el("span", "chev", "›"), document.createTextNode(section.title));
    const owned = groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id).length;
    label.append(el("span", "count", String(owned)));
    tree.append(label);

    const tray = el("div", "pool");
    tray.dataset.sectionId = section.id;
    tray.append(el("div", "cap", section.title + " pool"));
    const parked = poolTabs(section.id);
    if (parked.length === 0) tray.append(el("div", "empty", "Drop or send tabs here. They stay open."));
    for (const tab of parked) {
      const home = groupById(tab.origin?.groupId ?? tab.groupId);
      const row = tabRow(tab, home ? "returns to " + home.title : "");
      tray.append(row);
    }
    tree.append(tray);

    for (const group of groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id && !g.peeled)) {
      const kids = tabsInGroup(group.id);
      const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === group.id ? " selected" : ""));
      const bar = el("span", "bar");
      bar.style.background = group.color;
      row.append(bar, el("span", "chev", "›"), el("span", "name", group.title));
      const meta = group.dock ? "on screen" : "not on screen";
      row.append(el("span", "meta", kids.length + " · " + meta));
      row.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sideSelected = group.id;
        say("Selected the " + group.title + " group. The pane stayed where it is.");
        render();
      });
      row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, groupMenu(group)));
      tree.append(row);
      for (const tab of kids) tree.append(tabRow(tab, ""));
    }
  }
}

function tabRow(tab, hint) {
  const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === tab.id ? " selected" : ""));
  row.style.paddingLeft = "28px";
  const name = el("span", "name");
  name.textContent = tab.title;
  if (hint) name.append(el("span", "home-hint", hint));
  row.append(el("span", "chev", "·"), name);
  if (tab.poolSectionId) row.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
  row.addEventListener("click", () => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    say("Selected “" + tab.title + "”. Nothing opened and nothing moved.");
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    openMenu(evt, tabMenu([tab.id], "sidebar"));
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
  return row;
}

function renderWorkspace() {
  workspace.replaceChildren();
  for (const edge of ["top", "left", "main", "right", "bottom"]) {
    const cell = el("div", "cell");
    cell.dataset.edge = edge;
    for (const group of visibleGroups().filter((g) => (g.dock || "main") === edge)) {
      cell.append(frameFor(group));
    }
    workspace.append(cell);
  }
}

function frameFor(group) {
  const frame = el("div", "frame" + (group.dock && group.dock !== "main" ? " docked" : ""));
  const bar = el("div", "tabbar");
  const strip = el("div", "tabs");
  for (const tab of tabsInGroup(group.id)) {
    const chip = el("div", "chip" + (tab.id === activeId ? " active" : "") + (selected.has(tab.id) ? " picked" : ""));
    const label = el("span", "label", tab.title);
    chip.append(label);
    if (tab.poolSectionId) chip.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
    chip.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
      if (evt.ctrlKey || evt.metaKey) {
        if (selected.has(tab.id)) selected.delete(tab.id);
        else selected.add(tab.id);
        say(selected.size + " tabs selected. Right-click to send them. The pane stayed put.");
      } else {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
        say("Showing “" + tab.title + "” in the pane already on screen.");
      }
      render();
    });
    chip.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
      const ids = selected.has(tab.id) && selected.size > 1 ? [...selected] : [tab.id];
      if (ids.length === 1) {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
      }
      openMenu(evt, tabMenu(ids, "tab"));
      render();
    });
    strip.append(chip);
  }
  const stack = el("div", "stack-btn", "▾");
  stack.title = "Tab stack";
  stack.addEventListener("click", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  stack.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  bar.append(strip, stack);
  const doc = el("div", "doc");
  const shown = tabById(activeId);
  const inThis = shown && shown.groupId === group.id && !shown.poolSectionId;
  doc.append(el("h2", "", inThis ? shown.title : group.title));
  doc.append(el("p", "", inThis
    ? "This note is already in this pane. Selecting it here does not create a split."
    : "This pane belongs to " + group.title + "."));
  frame.append(bar, doc);
  return frame;
}

function groupMenu(group) {
  return {
    title: group.title,
    items: [
      { label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) },
      { sep: true },
      { label: "Obsidian: Close all", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own Close all.") },
    ],
  };
}

function stackMenu(group) {
  const items = tabsInGroup(group.id).map((tab) => ({
    label: tab.title,
    run: () => {
      selected = new Set([tab.id]);
      activeId = tab.id;
      say("Picked “" + tab.title + "” from the stack. The pane stayed put.");
      render();
    },
  }));
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({ label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) });
  items.push({
    label: "Send every tab to pool",
    hint: "leaves stay",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(tabsInGroup(group.id).map((t) => t.id), section.id),
    })),
  });
  return { title: "Stack · " + group.title, hint: "Dock moves every tab in this pane together.", items };
}

function tabMenu(ids, source) {
  const many = ids.length > 1;
  const first = tabById(ids[0]);
  const items = [];
  if (source === "tab") {
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Close selected" : "Obsidian: Close", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Pin selected" : "Obsidian: Pin", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ sep: true });
  }
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to pool" : "Send to pool",
    hint: "leaf stays",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(ids, section.id),
    })),
  });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to group" : "Send to group",
    hint: "no reveal",
    children: groups.filter((g) => !g.peeled).map((group) => ({
      label: group.title,
      dim: ids.every((id) => tabById(id).groupId === group.id && !tabById(id).poolSectionId),
      run: () => sendToGroup(ids, group.id),
    })),
  });
  const returnable = ids.filter((id) => tabById(id).origin);
  if (returnable.length) {
    items.push({
      label: returnable.length > 1 ? "Return each to its own group" : "Return to " + (groupById(tabById(returnable[0]).origin.groupId)?.title ?? "origin"),
      run: () => restore(returnable),
    });
  }
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Dock selected together" : "Dock this tab",
    hint: "one pane",
    children: dockItems((edge) => peel(ids, edge)),
  });
  return { title: many ? ids.length + " tabs" : first.title, hint: source === "sidebar" ? "Same commands as the tab header." : "", items };
}

function dockItems(run) {
  return [
    ["Dock left", "left"],
    ["Dock right", "right"],
    ["Dock top", "top"],
    ["Dock bottom", "bottom"],
  ].map(([label, edge]) => ({ label, run: () => run(edge) }));
}

function sendToPool(ids, sectionId) {
  const section = sectionById(sectionId);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) tab.origin = { groupId: tab.groupId, order: tab.order };
    tab.poolSectionId = sectionId;
  }
  selected = new Set(ids);
  say("Filed " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " in the " + section.title + " pool. " + (ids.length > 1 ? "They remember" : "It remembers") + " where " + (ids.length > 1 ? "they" : "it") + " came from. No pane moved.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function sendToGroup(ids, groupId) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  let order = tabsInGroup(groupId).reduce((max, tab) => Math.max(max, tab.order), -1);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (tab.groupId === groupId && !tab.poolSectionId) continue;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = groupId;
    tab.order = ++order;
    if (!group.dock) group.dock = null;
  }
  say("Sent " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " to " + group.title + ". " + (group.dock ? "That pane is on screen." : "That pane stayed off screen, and this view did not jump to it.") + " This is their new home.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function restore(ids) {
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) continue;
    tab.groupId = tab.origin.groupId;
    tab.order = tab.origin.order;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
  }
  say("Put back in the group " + (ids.length > 1 ? "each tab" : "it") + " left. The view did not jump.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function dockGroup(groupId, edge) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  group.dock = edge;
  say("Docked the " + group.title + " pane to the " + edge + ". Every tab in that pane moved together.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function peel(ids, edge) {
  const id = "peel" + seq++;
  const title = ids.length === 1 ? tabById(ids[0]).title : ids.length + " tabs";
  groups.push({ id, title, sectionId: "work", color: "#7eb6d6", dock: edge, peeled: true });
  let order = 0;
  for (const tabId of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(tabId);
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = id;
    tab.order = order++;
  }
  say("Peeled " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " into " + (ids.length > 1 ? "their" : "its") + " own pane on the " + edge + ". The rest of the group stayed.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function openMenu(evt, spec) {
  evt.preventDefault();
  evt.stopPropagation();
  menu.replaceChildren();
  if (spec.hint) menu.append(el("div", "hint", spec.hint));
  for (const item of spec.items) {
    if (item.sep) {
      menu.append(el("div", "sep"));
      continue;
    }
    const row = el("div", "mi" + (item.dim ? " dim" : ""));
    row.append(document.createTextNode(item.label));
    if (item.hint) row.append(el("span", "k", item.hint));
    if (item.children) {
      row.append(el("span", "k", "›"));
      const sub = el("div", "sub");
      for (const child of item.children) {
        const subRow = el("div", "mi" + (child.dim ? " dim" : ""), child.label);
        subRow.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (!child.dim) child.run();
        });
        sub.append(subRow);
      }
      row.append(sub);
      row.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => row.classList.add("open"));
      row.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => row.classList.remove("open"));
    } else {
      row.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        item.run();
      });
    }
    menu.append(row);
  }
  menu.classList.remove("hidden");
  const pad = 8;
  const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
  let x = evt.clientX;
  let y = evt.clientY;
  if (x + rect.width > window.innerWidth - pad) x = window.innerWidth - rect.width - pad;
  if (y + rect.height > window.innerHeight - pad) y = window.innerHeight - rect.height - pad;
  menu.style.left = x + "px";
  menu.style.top = y + "px";
}

function closeMenu() { menu.classList.add("hidden"); }

function el(tag, className, text) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (className) node.className = className;
  if (text != null) node.textContent = text;
  return node;
}

document.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
  if (!menu.contains(evt.target)) closeMenu();
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (evt) => {
  if (evt.key === "Escape") closeMenu();
});

render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```
<body>
  <div class="brief">
    <h1>Working tabs wireframe</h1>
    <p>Click only selects. The tab stack docks the whole pane. A tab’s own menu sends that tab into a pool or another group. Ctrl-click several tabs, then right-click, to send them together. Right-click a sidebar row for the same send commands.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="stage">
    <div class="window">
      <aside>
        <input class="search" value="" placeholder="Search tabs and groups…" disabled />
        <div class="tree" id="tree"></div>
      </aside>
      <main>
        <div class="workspace" id="workspace"></div>
      </main>
      <div class="status" id="status">Click a tab to select it. The pane stays where it is.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="menu" class="menu hidden"></div>
<script>
const sections = [
  { id: "nav", title: "Navigation", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "work", title: "Work", color: "#e08b3c" },
];

let groups = [
  { id: "sast", title: "SAST", sectionId: "nav", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "main", title: "Main", sectionId: "nav", color: "#8b6fd6" },
  { id: "home", title: "Home", sectionId: "nav", color: "#43a047" },
  { id: "qisl", title: "QISL Platform", sectionId: "work", color: "#e08b3c", dock: "main" },
  { id: "harness", title: "Tool Harness", sectionId: "work", color: "#2fa3a3" },
  { id: "sfa", title: "SFA", sectionId: "work", color: "#4a7fe0" },
  { id: "pay", title: "Payment Gateway", sectionId: "work", color: "#d0a215" },
  { id: "ext", title: "External Services", sectionId: "work", color: "#d1453b" },
];

let tabs = [
  { id: "a", title: "Architecture and Design of a Decoupled…", groupId: "qisl", order: 0 },
  { id: "b", title: "Session Recovery — Backend Gr…", groupId: "qisl", order: 1 },
  { id: "c", title: "Belial Dreams", groupId: "qisl", order: 2 },
  { id: "d", title: "Terminus 1", groupId: "qisl", order: 3 },
  { id: "e", title: "QISL Platform", groupId: "qisl", order: 4 },
  { id: "f", title: "Payment notes", groupId: "ext", order: 0 },
  { id: "g", title: "Theme registry", groupId: "harness", order: 0 },
];

let activeId = "e";
let selected = new Set(["e"]);
let sideSelected = null;
let seq = 1;

const tree = document.getElementById("tree");
const workspace = document.getElementById("workspace");
const status = document.getElementById("status");
const menu = document.getElementById("menu");

function groupById(id) { return groups.find((g) => g.id === id); }
function sectionById(id) { return sections.find((s) => s.id === id); }
function tabById(id) { return tabs.find((t) => t.id === id); }

function say(text) { status.textContent = text; }

function tabsInGroup(groupId) {
  return tabs
    .filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId && !t.poolSectionId)
    .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

function poolTabs(sectionId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.poolSectionId === sectionId);
}

function visibleGroups() {
  return groups.filter((g) => g.dock);
}

function render() {
  renderTree();
  renderWorkspace();
}

function renderTree() {
  tree.replaceChildren();
  for (const section of sections) {
    const label = el("div", "sec-label");
    label.append(el("span", "chev", "›"), document.createTextNode(section.title));
    const owned = groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id).length;
    label.append(el("span", "count", String(owned)));
    tree.append(label);

    const tray = el("div", "pool");
    tray.dataset.sectionId = section.id;
    tray.append(el("div", "cap", section.title + " pool"));
    const parked = poolTabs(section.id);
    if (parked.length === 0) tray.append(el("div", "empty", "Drop or send tabs here. They stay open."));
    for (const tab of parked) {
      const home = groupById(tab.origin?.groupId ?? tab.groupId);
      const row = tabRow(tab, home ? "returns to " + home.title : "");
      tray.append(row);
    }
    tree.append(tray);

    for (const group of groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id && !g.peeled)) {
      const kids = tabsInGroup(group.id);
      const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === group.id ? " selected" : ""));
      const bar = el("span", "bar");
      bar.style.background = group.color;
      row.append(bar, el("span", "chev", "›"), el("span", "name", group.title));
      const meta = group.dock ? "on screen" : "not on screen";
      row.append(el("span", "meta", kids.length + " · " + meta));
      row.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sideSelected = group.id;
        say("Selected the " + group.title + " group. The pane stayed where it is.");
        render();
      });
      row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, groupMenu(group)));
      tree.append(row);
      for (const tab of kids) tree.append(tabRow(tab, ""));
    }
  }
}

function tabRow(tab, hint) {
  const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === tab.id ? " selected" : ""));
  row.style.paddingLeft = "28px";
  const name = el("span", "name");
  name.textContent = tab.title;
  if (hint) name.append(el("span", "home-hint", hint));
  row.append(el("span", "chev", "·"), name);
  if (tab.poolSectionId) row.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
  row.addEventListener("click", () => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    say("Selected “" + tab.title + "”. Nothing opened and nothing moved.");
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    openMenu(evt, tabMenu([tab.id], "sidebar"));
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
  return row;
}

function renderWorkspace() {
  workspace.replaceChildren();
  for (const edge of ["top", "left", "main", "right", "bottom"]) {
    const cell = el("div", "cell");
    cell.dataset.edge = edge;
    for (const group of visibleGroups().filter((g) => (g.dock || "main") === edge)) {
      cell.append(frameFor(group));
    }
    workspace.append(cell);
  }
}

function frameFor(group) {
  const frame = el("div", "frame" + (group.dock && group.dock !== "main" ? " docked" : ""));
  const bar = el("div", "tabbar");
  const strip = el("div", "tabs");
  for (const tab of tabsInGroup(group.id)) {
    const chip = el("div", "chip" + (tab.id === activeId ? " active" : "") + (selected.has(tab.id) ? " picked" : ""));
    const label = el("span", "label", tab.title);
    chip.append(label);
    if (tab.poolSectionId) chip.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
    chip.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
      if (evt.ctrlKey || evt.metaKey) {
        if (selected.has(tab.id)) selected.delete(tab.id);
        else selected.add(tab.id);
        say(selected.size + " tabs selected. Right-click to send them. The pane stayed put.");
      } else {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
        say("Showing “" + tab.title + "” in the pane already on screen.");
      }
      render();
    });
    chip.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
      const ids = selected.has(tab.id) && selected.size > 1 ? [...selected] : [tab.id];
      if (ids.length === 1) {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
      }
      openMenu(evt, tabMenu(ids, "tab"));
      render();
    });
    strip.append(chip);
  }
  const stack = el("div", "stack-btn", "▾");
  stack.title = "Tab stack";
  stack.addEventListener("click", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  stack.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  bar.append(strip, stack);
  const doc = el("div", "doc");
  const shown = tabById(activeId);
  const inThis = shown && shown.groupId === group.id && !shown.poolSectionId;
  doc.append(el("h2", "", inThis ? shown.title : group.title));
  doc.append(el("p", "", inThis
    ? "This note is already in this pane. Selecting it here does not create a split."
    : "This pane belongs to " + group.title + "."));
  frame.append(bar, doc);
  return frame;
}

function groupMenu(group) {
  return {
    title: group.title,
    items: [
      { label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) },
      { sep: true },
      { label: "Obsidian: Close all", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own Close all.") },
    ],
  };
}

function stackMenu(group) {
  const items = tabsInGroup(group.id).map((tab) => ({
    label: tab.title,
    run: () => {
      selected = new Set([tab.id]);
      activeId = tab.id;
      say("Picked “" + tab.title + "” from the stack. The pane stayed put.");
      render();
    },
  }));
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({ label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) });
  items.push({
    label: "Send every tab to pool",
    hint: "leaves stay",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(tabsInGroup(group.id).map((t) => t.id), section.id),
    })),
  });
  return { title: "Stack · " + group.title, hint: "Dock moves every tab in this pane together.", items };
}

function tabMenu(ids, source) {
  const many = ids.length > 1;
  const first = tabById(ids[0]);
  const items = [];
  if (source === "tab") {
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Close selected" : "Obsidian: Close", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Pin selected" : "Obsidian: Pin", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ sep: true });
  }
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to pool" : "Send to pool",
    hint: "leaf stays",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(ids, section.id),
    })),
  });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to group" : "Send to group",
    hint: "no reveal",
    children: groups.filter((g) => !g.peeled).map((group) => ({
      label: group.title,
      dim: ids.every((id) => tabById(id).groupId === group.id && !tabById(id).poolSectionId),
      run: () => sendToGroup(ids, group.id),
    })),
  });
  const returnable = ids.filter((id) => tabById(id).origin);
  if (returnable.length) {
    items.push({
      label: returnable.length > 1 ? "Return each to its own group" : "Return to " + (groupById(tabById(returnable[0]).origin.groupId)?.title ?? "origin"),
      run: () => restore(returnable),
    });
  }
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Dock selected together" : "Dock this tab",
    hint: "one pane",
    children: dockItems((edge) => peel(ids, edge)),
  });
  return { title: many ? ids.length + " tabs" : first.title, hint: source === "sidebar" ? "Same commands as the tab header." : "", items };
}

function dockItems(run) {
  return [
    ["Dock left", "left"],
    ["Dock right", "right"],
    ["Dock top", "top"],
    ["Dock bottom", "bottom"],
  ].map(([label, edge]) => ({ label, run: () => run(edge) }));
}

function sendToPool(ids, sectionId) {
  const section = sectionById(sectionId);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) tab.origin = { groupId: tab.groupId, order: tab.order };
    tab.poolSectionId = sectionId;
  }
  selected = new Set(ids);
  say("Filed " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " in the " + section.title + " pool. " + (ids.length > 1 ? "They remember" : "It remembers") + " where " + (ids.length > 1 ? "they" : "it") + " came from. No pane moved.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function sendToGroup(ids, groupId) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  let order = tabsInGroup(groupId).reduce((max, tab) => Math.max(max, tab.order), -1);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (tab.groupId === groupId && !tab.poolSectionId) continue;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = groupId;
    tab.order = ++order;
    if (!group.dock) group.dock = null;
  }
  say("Sent " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " to " + group.title + ". " + (group.dock ? "That pane is on screen." : "That pane stayed off screen, and this view did not jump to it.") + " This is their new home.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function restore(ids) {
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) continue;
    tab.groupId = tab.origin.groupId;
    tab.order = tab.origin.order;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
  }
  say("Put back in the group " + (ids.length > 1 ? "each tab" : "it") + " left. The view did not jump.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function dockGroup(groupId, edge) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  group.dock = edge;
  say("Docked the " + group.title + " pane to the " + edge + ". Every tab in that pane moved together.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function peel(ids, edge) {
  const id = "peel" + seq++;
  const title = ids.length === 1 ? tabById(ids[0]).title : ids.length + " tabs";
  groups.push({ id, title, sectionId: "work", color: "#7eb6d6", dock: edge, peeled: true });
  let order = 0;
  for (const tabId of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(tabId);
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = id;
    tab.order = order++;
  }
  say("Peeled " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " into " + (ids.length > 1 ? "their" : "its") + " own pane on the " + edge + ". The rest of the group stayed.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function openMenu(evt, spec) {
  evt.preventDefault();
  evt.stopPropagation();
  menu.replaceChildren();
  if (spec.hint) menu.append(el("div", "hint", spec.hint));
  for (const item of spec.items) {
    if (item.sep) {
      menu.append(el("div", "sep"));
      continue;
    }
    const row = el("div", "mi" + (item.dim ? " dim" : ""));
    row.append(document.createTextNode(item.label));
    if (item.hint) row.append(el("span", "k", item.hint));
    if (item.children) {
      row.append(el("span", "k", "›"));
      const sub = el("div", "sub");
      for (const child of item.children) {
        const subRow = el("div", "mi" + (child.dim ? " dim" : ""), child.label);
        subRow.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (!child.dim) child.run();
        });
        sub.append(subRow);
      }
      row.append(sub);
      row.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => row.classList.add("open"));
      row.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => row.classList.remove("open"));
    } else {
      row.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        item.run();
      });
    }
    menu.append(row);
  }
  menu.classList.remove("hidden");
  const pad = 8;
  const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
  let x = evt.clientX;
  let y = evt.clientY;
  if (x + rect.width > window.innerWidth - pad) x = window.innerWidth - rect.width - pad;
  if (y + rect.height > window.innerHeight - pad) y = window.innerHeight - rect.height - pad;
  menu.style.left = x + "px";
  menu.style.top = y + "px";
}

function closeMenu() { menu.classList.add("hidden"); }

function el(tag, className, text) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (className) node.className = className;
  if (text != null) node.textContent = text;
  return node;
}

document.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
  if (!menu.contains(evt.target)) closeMenu();
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (evt) => {
  if (evt.key === "Escape") closeMenu();
});

render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```
  <div class="brief">
    <h1>Working tabs wireframe</h1>
    <p>Click only selects. The tab stack docks the whole pane. A tab’s own menu sends that tab into a pool or another group. Ctrl-click several tabs, then right-click, to send them together. Right-click a sidebar row for the same send commands.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="stage">
    <div class="window">
      <aside>

        <div class="tree" id="tree"></div>

<script>
const sections = [
  { id: "nav", title: "Navigation", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "work", title: "Work", color: "#e08b3c" },
];

let groups = [
  { id: "sast", title: "SAST", sectionId: "nav", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "main", title: "Main", sectionId: "nav", color: "#8b6fd6" },
  { id: "home", title: "Home", sectionId: "nav", color: "#43a047" },
  { id: "qisl", title: "QISL Platform", sectionId: "work", color: "#e08b3c", dock: "main" },
  { id: "harness", title: "Tool Harness", sectionId: "work", color: "#2fa3a3" },
  { id: "sfa", title: "SFA", sectionId: "work", color: "#4a7fe0" },
  { id: "pay", title: "Payment Gateway", sectionId: "work", color: "#d0a215" },
  { id: "ext", title: "External Services", sectionId: "work", color: "#d1453b" },
];

let tabs = [
  { id: "a", title: "Architecture and Design of a Decoupled…", groupId: "qisl", order: 0 },
  { id: "b", title: "Session Recovery — Backend Gr…", groupId: "qisl", order: 1 },
  { id: "c", title: "Belial Dreams", groupId: "qisl", order: 2 },
  { id: "d", title: "Terminus 1", groupId: "qisl", order: 3 },
  { id: "e", title: "QISL Platform", groupId: "qisl", order: 4 },
  { id: "f", title: "Payment notes", groupId: "ext", order: 0 },
  { id: "g", title: "Theme registry", groupId: "harness", order: 0 },
];

let activeId = "e";
let selected = new Set(["e"]);
let sideSelected = null;
let seq = 1;

const tree = document.getElementById("tree");
const workspace = document.getElementById("workspace");
const status = document.getElementById("status");
const menu = document.getElementById("menu");

function groupById(id) { return groups.find((g) => g.id === id); }
function sectionById(id) { return sections.find((s) => s.id === id); }
function tabById(id) { return tabs.find((t) => t.id === id); }

function say(text) { status.textContent = text; }

function tabsInGroup(groupId) {
  return tabs
    .filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId && !t.poolSectionId)
    .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

/** Open leaves stay in the pane even after the sidebar row is filed in a pool. */
function tabsOnPane(groupId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

function poolTabs(sectionId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.poolSectionId === sectionId);
}

function visibleGroups() {
  return groups.filter((g) => g.dock);
}

function render() {
  renderTree();
  renderWorkspace();
}

function renderTree() {
  tree.replaceChildren();
  for (const section of sections) {
    const label = el("div", "sec-label");
    label.append(el("span", "chev", "›"), document.createTextNode(section.title));
    const owned = groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id).length;
    label.append(el("span", "count", String(owned)));
    tree.append(label);

    const tray = el("div", "pool");
    tray.dataset.sectionId = section.id;
    tray.append(el("div", "cap", section.title + " pool"));
    const parked = poolTabs(section.id);
    if (parked.length === 0) tray.append(el("div", "empty", "Drop or send tabs here. They stay open."));
    for (const tab of parked) {
      const home = groupById(tab.origin?.groupId ?? tab.groupId);
      const row = tabRow(tab, home ? "returns to " + home.title : "");
      tray.append(row);
    }
    tree.append(tray);

    for (const group of groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id && !g.peeled)) {
      const kids = tabsInGroup(group.id);
      const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === group.id ? " selected" : ""));
      const bar = el("span", "bar");
      bar.style.background = group.color;
      row.append(bar, el("span", "chev", "›"), el("span", "name", group.title));
      const meta = group.dock ? "on screen" : "not on screen";
      row.append(el("span", "meta", kids.length + " · " + meta));
      row.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sideSelected = group.id;
        say("Selected the " + group.title + " group. The pane stayed where it is.");
        render();
      });
      row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, groupMenu(group)));
      tree.append(row);
      for (const tab of kids) tree.append(tabRow(tab, ""));
    }
  }
}

function tabRow(tab, hint) {
  const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === tab.id ? " selected" : ""));
  row.style.paddingLeft = "28px";
  const name = el("span", "name");
  name.textContent = tab.title;
  if (hint) name.append(el("span", "home-hint", hint));
  row.append(el("span", "chev", "·"), name);
  if (tab.poolSectionId) row.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
  row.addEventListener("click", () => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    say("Selected “" + tab.title + "”. Nothing opened and nothing moved.");
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    openMenu(evt, tabMenu([tab.id], "sidebar"));
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
  return row;
}

function renderWorkspace() {
  workspace.replaceChildren();
  for (const edge of ["top", "left", "main", "right", "bottom"]) {
    const cell = el("div", "cell");
    cell.dataset.edge = edge;
    for (const group of visibleGroups().filter((g) => (g.dock || "main") === edge)) {
      cell.append(frameFor(group));
    }
    workspace.append(cell);
  }
}

function frameFor(group) {
  const frame = el("div", "frame" + (group.dock && group.dock !== "main" ? " docked" : ""));
  const bar = el("div", "tabbar");
  const strip = el("div", "tabs");
  for (const tab of tabsInGroup(group.id)) {
    const chip = el("div", "chip" + (tab.id === activeId ? " active" : "") + (selected.has(tab.id) ? " picked" : ""));
    const label = el("span", "label", tab.title);
    chip.append(label);
    if (tab.poolSectionId) chip.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
    chip.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
      if (evt.ctrlKey || evt.metaKey) {
        if (selected.has(tab.id)) selected.delete(tab.id);
        else selected.add(tab.id);
        say(selected.size + " tabs selected. Right-click to send them. The pane stayed put.");
      } else {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
        say("Showing “" + tab.title + "” in the pane already on screen.");
      }
      render();

    chip.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
      const ids = selected.has(tab.id) && selected.size > 1 ? [...selected] : [tab.id];

        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
      }
      openMenu(evt, tabMenu(ids, "tab"));
      render();
    });
    strip.append(chip);
  }
  const stack = el("div", "stack-btn", "▾");
  stack.title = "Tab stack";
  stack.addEventListener("click", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  stack.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  bar.append(strip, stack);
  const doc = el("div", "doc");
  const shown = tabById(activeId);
  const inThis = shown && shown.groupId === group.id && !shown.poolSectionId;
  doc.append(el("h2", "", inThis ? shown.title : group.title));
  doc.append(el("p", "", inThis
    ? "This note is already in this pane. Selecting it here does not create a split."
    : "This pane belongs to " + group.title + "."));
  frame.append(bar, doc);
  return frame;
}

function groupMenu(group) {
  return {
    title: group.title,
    items: [
      { label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) },
      { sep: true },
      { label: "Obsidian: Close all", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own Close all.") },
    ],
  };
}

function stackMenu(group) {
  const items = tabsInGroup(group.id).map((tab) => ({
    label: tab.title,
    run: () => {
      selected = new Set([tab.id]);
      activeId = tab.id;
      say("Picked “" + tab.title + "” from the stack. The pane stayed put.");
      render();
    },
  }));
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({ label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) });
  items.push({
    label: "Send every tab to pool",
    hint: "leaves stay",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(tabsInGroup(group.id).map((t) => t.id), section.id),
    })),
  });
  return { title: "Stack · " + group.title, hint: "Dock moves every tab in this pane together.", items };
}

function tabMenu(ids, source) {
  const many = ids.length > 1;
  const first = tabById(ids[0]);
  const items = [];
  if (source === "tab") {
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Close selected" : "Obsidian: Close", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Pin selected" : "Obsidian: Pin", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ sep: true });
  }
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to pool" : "Send to pool",
    hint: "leaf stays",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(ids, section.id),
    })),
  });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to group" : "Send to group",
    hint: "no reveal",
    children: groups.filter((g) => !g.peeled).map((group) => ({
      label: group.title,
      dim: ids.every((id) => tabById(id).groupId === group.id && !tabById(id).poolSectionId),
      run: () => sendToGroup(ids, group.id),
    })),
  });
  const returnable = ids.filter((id) => tabById(id).origin);
  if (returnable.length) {
    items.push({
      label: returnable.length > 1 ? "Return each to its own group" : "Return to " + (groupById(tabById(returnable[0]).origin.groupId)?.title ?? "origin"),
      run: () => restore(returnable),
    });
  }
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Dock selected together" : "Dock this tab",
    hint: "one pane",
    children: dockItems((edge) => peel(ids, edge)),
  });
  return { title: many ? ids.length + " tabs" : first.title, hint: source === "sidebar" ? "Same commands as the tab header." : "", items };
}

function dockItems(run) {
  return [
    ["Dock left", "left"],
    ["Dock right", "right"],
    ["Dock top", "top"],
    ["Dock bottom", "bottom"],
  ].map(([label, edge]) => ({ label, run: () => run(edge) }));
}

function sendToPool(ids, sectionId) {
  const section = sectionById(sectionId);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) tab.origin = { groupId: tab.groupId, order: tab.order };
    tab.poolSectionId = sectionId;
  }
  selected = new Set(ids);
  say("Filed " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " in the " + section.title + " pool. " + (ids.length > 1 ? "They remember" : "It remembers") + " where " + (ids.length > 1 ? "they" : "it") + " came from. No pane moved.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function sendToGroup(ids, groupId) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  let order = tabsInGroup(groupId).reduce((max, tab) => Math.max(max, tab.order), -1);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (tab.groupId === groupId && !tab.poolSectionId) continue;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = groupId;
    tab.order = ++order;
    if (!group.dock) group.dock = null;
  }
  say("Sent " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " to " + group.title + ". " + (group.dock ? "That pane is on screen." : "That pane stayed off screen, and this view did not jump to it.") + " This is their new home.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function restore(ids) {
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) continue;
    tab.groupId = tab.origin.groupId;
    tab.order = tab.origin.order;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
  }
  say("Put back in the group " + (ids.length > 1 ? "each tab" : "it") + " left. The view did not jump.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function dockGroup(groupId, edge) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  group.dock = edge;
  say("Docked the " + group.title + " pane to the " + edge + ". Every tab in that pane moved together.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function peel(ids, edge) {
  const id = "peel" + seq++;
  const title = ids.length === 1 ? tabById(ids[0]).title : ids.length + " tabs";
  groups.push({ id, title, sectionId: "work", color: "#7eb6d6", dock: edge, peeled: true });
  let order = 0;
  for (const tabId of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(tabId);
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = id;
    tab.order = order++;
  }
  say("Peeled " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " into " + (ids.length > 1 ? "their" : "its") + " own pane on the " + edge + ". The rest of the group stayed.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function openMenu(evt, spec) {
  evt.preventDefault();
  evt.stopPropagation();
  menu.replaceChildren();
  if (spec.hint) menu.append(el("div", "hint", spec.hint));
  for (const item of spec.items) {
    if (item.sep) {
      menu.append(el("div", "sep"));
      continue;
    }
    const row = el("div", "mi" + (item.dim ? " dim" : ""));
    row.append(document.createTextNode(item.label));
    if (item.hint) row.append(el("span", "k", item.hint));
    if (item.children) {
      row.append(el("span", "k", "›"));
      const sub = el("div", "sub");
      for (const child of item.children) {
        const subRow = el("div", "mi" + (child.dim ? " dim" : ""), child.label);
        subRow.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (!child.dim) child.run();
        });
        sub.append(subRow);
      }
      row.append(sub);
      row.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => row.classList.add("open"));
      row.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => row.classList.remove("open"));
    } else {
      row.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        item.run();
      });
    }
    menu.append(row);
  }
  menu.classList.remove("hidden");
  const pad = 8;
  const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
  let x = evt.clientX;
  let y = evt.clientY;
  if (x + rect.width > window.innerWidth - pad) x = window.innerWidth - rect.width - pad;
  if (y + rect.height > window.innerHeight - pad) y = window.innerHeight - rect.height - pad;
  menu.style.left = x + "px";
  menu.style.top = y + "px";
}

function closeMenu() { menu.classList.add("hidden"); }

function el(tag, className, text) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (className) node.className = className;
  if (text != null) node.textContent = text;
  return node;
}

document.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
  if (!menu.contains(evt.target)) closeMenu();
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (evt) => {
  if (evt.key === "Escape") closeMenu();
});

render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```
  <div class="brief">
    <h1>Working tabs wireframe</h1>
    <p>Click only selects. The tab stack docks the whole pane. A tab’s own menu sends that tab into a pool or another group. Ctrl-click several tabs, then right-click, to send them together. Right-click a sidebar row for the same send commands.</p>
  </div>

<script>
const sections = [
  { id: "nav", title: "Navigation", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "work", title: "Work", color: "#e08b3c" },
];

let groups = [
  { id: "sast", title: "SAST", sectionId: "nav", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "main", title: "Main", sectionId: "nav", color: "#8b6fd6" },
  { id: "home", title: "Home", sectionId: "nav", color: "#43a047" },
  { id: "qisl", title: "QISL Platform", sectionId: "work", color: "#e08b3c", dock: "main" },
  { id: "harness", title: "Tool Harness", sectionId: "work", color: "#2fa3a3" },
  { id: "sfa", title: "SFA", sectionId: "work", color: "#4a7fe0" },
  { id: "pay", title: "Payment Gateway", sectionId: "work", color: "#d0a215" },
  { id: "ext", title: "External Services", sectionId: "work", color: "#d1453b" },
];

let tabs = [
  { id: "a", title: "Architecture and Design of a Decoupled…", groupId: "qisl", order: 0 },
  { id: "b", title: "Session Recovery — Backend Gr…", groupId: "qisl", order: 1 },
  { id: "c", title: "Belial Dreams", groupId: "qisl", order: 2 },
  { id: "d", title: "Terminus 1", groupId: "qisl", order: 3 },
  { id: "e", title: "QISL Platform", groupId: "qisl", order: 4 },
  { id: "f", title: "Payment notes", groupId: "ext", order: 0 },
  { id: "g", title: "Theme registry", groupId: "harness", order: 0 },
];

let activeId = "e";
let selected = new Set(["e"]);
let sideSelected = null;
let seq = 1;

const tree = document.getElementById("tree");
const workspace = document.getElementById("workspace");
const status = document.getElementById("status");
const menu = document.getElementById("menu");

function groupById(id) { return groups.find((g) => g.id === id); }
function sectionById(id) { return sections.find((s) => s.id === id); }
function tabById(id) { return tabs.find((t) => t.id === id); }

function say(text) { status.textContent = text; }

function tabsInGroup(groupId) {
  return tabs
    .filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId && !t.poolSectionId)
    .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

/** Open leaves stay in the pane even after the sidebar row is filed in a pool. */
function tabsOnPane(groupId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

function poolTabs(sectionId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.poolSectionId === sectionId);
}

function visibleGroups() {
  return groups.filter((g) => g.dock);
}

function render() {
  renderTree();
  renderWorkspace();
}

function renderTree() {
  tree.replaceChildren();
  for (const section of sections) {
    const label = el("div", "sec-label");
    label.append(el("span", "chev", "›"), document.createTextNode(section.title));
    const owned = groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id).length;
    label.append(el("span", "count", String(owned)));
    tree.append(label);

    const tray = el("div", "pool");
    tray.dataset.sectionId = section.id;
    tray.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
    tray.addEventListener("drop", (evt) => {
      evt.preventDefault();
      const ids = takeDrag(evt);
      if (ids.length) sendToPool(ids, section.id);

    tray.append(el("div", "cap", section.title + " pool"));
    const parked = poolTabs(section.id);
    if (parked.length === 0) tray.append(el("div", "empty", "Drop or send tabs here. They stay open."));
    for (const tab of parked) {
      const home = groupById(tab.origin?.groupId ?? tab.groupId);
      const row = tabRow(tab, home ? "returns to " + home.title : "");
      tray.append(row);
    }
    tree.append(tray);

    for (const group of groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id && !g.peeled)) {
      const kids = tabsInGroup(group.id);
      const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === group.id ? " selected" : ""));
      const bar = el("span", "bar");
      bar.style.background = group.color;
      row.append(bar, el("span", "chev", "›"), el("span", "name", group.title));
      const meta = group.dock ? "on screen" : "not on screen";
      row.append(el("span", "meta", kids.length + " · " + meta));
      row.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sideSelected = group.id;
        say("Selected the " + group.title + " group. The pane stayed where it is.");
        render();
      });
      row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, groupMenu(group)));
      tree.append(row);
      for (const tab of kids) tree.append(tabRow(tab, ""));
    }
  }
}

function tabRow(tab, hint) {
  const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === tab.id ? " selected" : ""));
  row.style.paddingLeft = "28px";
  const name = el("span", "name");
  name.textContent = tab.title;
  if (hint) name.append(el("span", "home-hint", hint));
  row.append(el("span", "chev", "·"), name);
  if (tab.poolSectionId) row.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
  row.addEventListener("click", () => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    say("Selected “" + tab.title + "”. Nothing opened and nothing moved.");
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    openMenu(evt, tabMenu([tab.id], "sidebar"));
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
  return row;
}

function renderWorkspace() {
  workspace.replaceChildren();
  for (const edge of ["top", "left", "main", "right", "bottom"]) {
    const cell = el("div", "cell");
    cell.dataset.edge = edge;
    for (const group of visibleGroups().filter((g) => (g.dock || "main") === edge)) {
      cell.append(frameFor(group));
    }
    workspace.append(cell);
  }
}

function frameFor(group) {
  const frame = el("div", "frame" + (group.dock && group.dock !== "main" ? " docked" : ""));
  const bar = el("div", "tabbar");
  const strip = el("div", "tabs");
  for (const tab of tabsInGroup(group.id)) {
    const chip = el("div", "chip" + (tab.id === activeId ? " active" : "") + (selected.has(tab.id) ? " picked" : ""));
    const label = el("span", "label", tab.title);
    chip.append(label);
    if (tab.poolSectionId) chip.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
    chip.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
      if (evt.ctrlKey || evt.metaKey) {
        if (selected.has(tab.id)) selected.delete(tab.id);
        else selected.add(tab.id);
        say(selected.size + " tabs selected. Right-click to send them. The pane stayed put.");
      } else {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
        say("Showing “" + tab.title + "” in the pane already on screen.");
      }
      render();
    });
    chip.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
      const ids = selected.has(tab.id) && selected.size > 1 ? [...selected] : [tab.id];
      if (ids.length === 1) {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
      }
      openMenu(evt, tabMenu(ids, "tab"));
      render();
    });
    strip.append(chip);
  }
  const stack = el("div", "stack-btn", "▾");
  stack.title = "Tab stack";
  stack.addEventListener("click", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  stack.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  bar.append(strip, stack);
  const doc = el("div", "doc");
  const shown = tabById(activeId);
  const inThis = shown && shown.groupId === group.id && !shown.poolSectionId;
  doc.append(el("h2", "", inThis ? shown.title : group.title));
  doc.append(el("p", "", inThis
    ? "This note is already in this pane. Selecting it here does not create a split."
    : "This pane belongs to " + group.title + "."));
  frame.append(bar, doc);
  return frame;
}

function groupMenu(group) {
  return {
    title: group.title,
    items: [
      { label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) },
      { sep: true },
      { label: "Obsidian: Close all", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own Close all.") },
    ],
  };
}

function stackMenu(group) {
  const items = tabsInGroup(group.id).map((tab) => ({
    label: tab.title,
    run: () => {
      selected = new Set([tab.id]);
      activeId = tab.id;
      say("Picked “" + tab.title + "” from the stack. The pane stayed put.");
      render();
    },
  }));
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({ label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) });
  items.push({
    label: "Send every tab to pool",
    hint: "leaves stay",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(tabsInGroup(group.id).map((t) => t.id), section.id),
    })),
  });
  return { title: "Stack · " + group.title, hint: "Dock moves every tab in this pane together.", items };
}

function tabMenu(ids, source) {
  const many = ids.length > 1;
  const first = tabById(ids[0]);
  const items = [];
  if (source === "tab") {
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Close selected" : "Obsidian: Close", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Pin selected" : "Obsidian: Pin", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ sep: true });
  }
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to pool" : "Send to pool",
    hint: "leaf stays",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(ids, section.id),
    })),
  });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to group" : "Send to group",
    hint: "no reveal",
    children: groups.filter((g) => !g.peeled).map((group) => ({
      label: group.title,
      dim: ids.every((id) => tabById(id).groupId === group.id && !tabById(id).poolSectionId),
      run: () => sendToGroup(ids, group.id),
    })),
  });
  const returnable = ids.filter((id) => tabById(id).origin);
  if (returnable.length) {
    items.push({
      label: returnable.length > 1 ? "Return each to its own group" : "Return to " + (groupById(tabById(returnable[0]).origin.groupId)?.title ?? "origin"),
      run: () => restore(returnable),
    });
  }
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Dock selected together" : "Dock this tab",
    hint: "one pane",
    children: dockItems((edge) => peel(ids, edge)),
  });
  return { title: many ? ids.length + " tabs" : first.title, hint: source === "sidebar" ? "Same commands as the tab header." : "", items };
}

function dockItems(run) {
  return [
    ["Dock left", "left"],
    ["Dock right", "right"],
    ["Dock top", "top"],
    ["Dock bottom", "bottom"],
  ].map(([label, edge]) => ({ label, run: () => run(edge) }));
}

function sendToPool(ids, sectionId) {
  const section = sectionById(sectionId);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) tab.origin = { groupId: tab.groupId, order: tab.order };
    tab.poolSectionId = sectionId;
  }
  selected = new Set(ids);
  say("Filed " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " in the " + section.title + " pool. " + (ids.length > 1 ? "They remember" : "It remembers") + " where " + (ids.length > 1 ? "they" : "it") + " came from. No pane moved.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function sendToGroup(ids, groupId) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  let order = tabsInGroup(groupId).reduce((max, tab) => Math.max(max, tab.order), -1);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (tab.groupId === groupId && !tab.poolSectionId) continue;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = groupId;
    tab.order = ++order;
    if (!group.dock) group.dock = null;
  }
  say("Sent " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " to " + group.title + ". " + (group.dock ? "That pane is on screen." : "That pane stayed off screen, and this view did not jump to it.") + " This is their new home.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function restore(ids) {
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) continue;
    tab.groupId = tab.origin.groupId;
    tab.order = tab.origin.order;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
  }
  say("Put back in the group " + (ids.length > 1 ? "each tab" : "it") + " left. The view did not jump.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function dockGroup(groupId, edge) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  group.dock = edge;
  say("Docked the " + group.title + " pane to the " + edge + ". Every tab in that pane moved together.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function peel(ids, edge) {
  const id = "peel" + seq++;
  const title = ids.length === 1 ? tabById(ids[0]).title : ids.length + " tabs";
  groups.push({ id, title, sectionId: "work", color: "#7eb6d6", dock: edge, peeled: true });
  let order = 0;
  for (const tabId of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(tabId);
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = id;
    tab.order = order++;
  }
  say("Peeled " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " into " + (ids.length > 1 ? "their" : "its") + " own pane on the " + edge + ". The rest of the group stayed.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function openMenu(evt, spec) {
  evt.preventDefault();
  evt.stopPropagation();
  menu.replaceChildren();
  if (spec.hint) menu.append(el("div", "hint", spec.hint));
  for (const item of spec.items) {
    if (item.sep) {
      menu.append(el("div", "sep"));
      continue;
    }
    const row = el("div", "mi" + (item.dim ? " dim" : ""));
    row.append(document.createTextNode(item.label));
    if (item.hint) row.append(el("span", "k", item.hint));
    if (item.children) {
      row.append(el("span", "k", "›"));
      const sub = el("div", "sub");
      for (const child of item.children) {
        const subRow = el("div", "mi" + (child.dim ? " dim" : ""), child.label);
        subRow.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (!child.dim) child.run();
        });
        sub.append(subRow);
      }
      row.append(sub);
      row.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => row.classList.add("open"));
      row.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => row.classList.remove("open"));
    } else {
      row.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        item.run();
      });
    }
    menu.append(row);
  }
  menu.classList.remove("hidden");
  const pad = 8;
  const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
  let x = evt.clientX;
  let y = evt.clientY;
  if (x + rect.width > window.innerWidth - pad) x = window.innerWidth - rect.width - pad;
  if (y + rect.height > window.innerHeight - pad) y = window.innerHeight - rect.height - pad;
  menu.style.left = x + "px";
  menu.style.top = y + "px";
}

function closeMenu() { menu.classList.add("hidden"); }

function el(tag, className, text) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (className) node.className = className;
  if (text != null) node.textContent = text;
  return node;
}

document.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
  if (!menu.contains(evt.target)) closeMenu();
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (evt) => {
  if (evt.key === "Escape") closeMenu();
});

render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

```
  <div class="brief">

<script>
const sections = [
  { id: "nav", title: "Navigation", color: "#d45d97" },

];

  { id: "sast", title: "SAST", sectionId: "nav", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "main", title: "Main", sectionId: "nav", color: "#8b6fd6" },
  { id: "home", title: "Home", sectionId: "nav", color: "#43a047" },
  { id: "qisl", title: "QISL Platform", sectionId: "work", color: "#e08b3c", dock: "main" },
  { id: "harness", title: "Tool Harness", sectionId: "work", color: "#2fa3a3" },
  { id: "sfa", title: "SFA", sectionId: "work", color: "#4a7fe0" },
  { id: "pay", title: "Payment Gateway", sectionId: "work", color: "#d0a215" },
  { id: "ext", title: "External Services", sectionId: "work", color: "#d1453b" },
];

  { id: "b", title: "Session Recovery — Backend Gr…", groupId: "qisl", order: 1 },

  { id: "f", title: "Payment notes", groupId: "ext", order: 0 },
  { id: "g", title: "Theme registry", groupId: "harness", order: 0 },

const workspace = document.getElementById("workspace");

function groupById(id) { return groups.find((g) => g.id === id); }
function sectionById(id) { return sections.find((s) => s.id === id); }
function tabById(id) { return tabs.find((t) => t.id === id); }

function tabsInGroup(groupId) {
  return tabs

}

function poolTabs(sectionId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.poolSectionId === sectionId);
}

function visibleGroups() {
  return groups.filter((g) => g.dock);
}

function render() {
  renderTree();
  renderWorkspace();
}

function renderTree() {
  tree.replaceChildren();
  for (const section of sections) {
    const label = el("div", "sec-label");
    label.append(el("span", "chev", "›"), document.createTextNode(section.title));
    const owned = groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id).length;
    label.append(el("span", "count", String(owned)));

    const tray = el("div", "pool");

    if (parked.length === 0) tray.append(el("div", "empty", "Drop or send tabs here. They stay open."));
    for (const tab of parked) {

      const row = tabRow(tab, home ? "returns to " + home.title : "");

    for (const group of groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id)) {
      const kids = tabsInGroup(group.id);
      const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === group.id ? " selected" : ""));
      const bar = el("span", "bar");
      bar.style.background = group.color;
      row.append(bar, el("span", "chev", "›"), el("span", "name", group.title));
      const meta = group.dock ? "on screen" : "not on screen";
      row.append(el("span", "meta", kids.length + " · " + meta));
      row.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sideSelected = group.id;

      tree.append(row);

}

function tabRow(tab, hint) {
  const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === tab.id ? " selected" : ""));
  row.style.paddingLeft = "28px";
  const name = el("span", "name");
  name.textContent = tab.title;
  if (hint) name.append(el("span", "home-hint", hint));
  row.append(el("span", "chev", "·"), name);
  if (tab.poolSectionId) row.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
  row.addEventListener("click", () => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    say("Selected “" + tab.title + "”. Nothing opened and nothing moved.");
    render();

  row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    openMenu(evt, tabMenu([tab.id], "sidebar"));
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
  return row;
}

function renderWorkspace() {
  workspace.replaceChildren();
  for (const edge of ["top", "left", "main", "right", "bottom"]) {
    const cell = el("div", "cell");
    cell.dataset.edge = edge;
    for (const group of visibleGroups().filter((g) => (g.dock || "main") === edge)) {
      cell.append(frameFor(group));
    }
    workspace.append(cell);

}

function frameFor(group) {
  const frame = el("div", "frame" + (group.dock && group.dock !== "main" ? " docked" : ""));
  const bar = el("div", "tabbar");
  const strip = el("div", "tabs");
  for (const tab of tabsInGroup(group.id)) {
    const chip = el("div", "chip" + (tab.id === activeId ? " active" : "") + (selected.has(tab.id) ? " picked" : ""));
    const label = el("span", "label", tab.title);
    chip.append(label);
    if (tab.poolSectionId) chip.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
    chip.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
      if (evt.ctrlKey || evt.metaKey) {
        if (selected.has(tab.id)) selected.delete(tab.id);
        else selected.add(tab.id);

      } else {
```
