<body>
  <div class="brief">
    <h1>Working tabs wireframe</h1>
    <p>Click only selects. The tab stack docks the whole pane. A tab’s own menu sends that tab into a pool or another group. Ctrl-click several tabs, then right-click, to send them together. Right-click a sidebar row for the same send commands.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="stage">
    <div class="window">
      <aside>
        <input class="search" value="" placeholder="Search tabs and groups…" disabled />
        <div class="tree" id="tree"></div>
      </aside>
      <main>
        <div class="workspace" id="workspace"></div>
      </main>
      <div class="status" id="status">Click a tab to select it. The pane stays where it is.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="menu" class="menu hidden"></div>
<script>
const sections = [
  { id: "nav", title: "Navigation", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "work", title: "Work", color: "#e08b3c" },
];

let groups = [
  { id: "sast", title: "SAST", sectionId: "nav", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "main", title: "Main", sectionId: "nav", color: "#8b6fd6" },
  { id: "home", title: "Home", sectionId: "nav", color: "#43a047" },
  { id: "qisl", title: "QISL Platform", sectionId: "work", color: "#e08b3c", dock: "main" },
  { id: "harness", title: "Tool Harness", sectionId: "work", color: "#2fa3a3" },
  { id: "sfa", title: "SFA", sectionId: "work", color: "#4a7fe0" },
  { id: "pay", title: "Payment Gateway", sectionId: "work", color: "#d0a215" },
  { id: "ext", title: "External Services", sectionId: "work", color: "#d1453b" },
];

let tabs = [
  { id: "a", title: "Architecture and Design of a Decoupled…", groupId: "qisl", order: 0 },
  { id: "b", title: "Session Recovery — Backend Gr…", groupId: "qisl", order: 1 },
  { id: "c", title: "Belial Dreams", groupId: "qisl", order: 2 },
  { id: "d", title: "Terminus 1", groupId: "qisl", order: 3 },
  { id: "e", title: "QISL Platform", groupId: "qisl", order: 4 },
  { id: "f", title: "Payment notes", groupId: "ext", order: 0 },
  { id: "g", title: "Theme registry", groupId: "harness", order: 0 },
];

let activeId = "e";
let selected = new Set(["e"]);
let sideSelected = null;
let seq = 1;

const tree = document.getElementById("tree");
const workspace = document.getElementById("workspace");
const status = document.getElementById("status");
const menu = document.getElementById("menu");

function groupById(id) { return groups.find((g) => g.id === id); }
function sectionById(id) { return sections.find((s) => s.id === id); }
function tabById(id) { return tabs.find((t) => t.id === id); }

function say(text) { status.textContent = text; }

function tabsInGroup(groupId) {
  return tabs
    .filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId && !t.poolSectionId)
    .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

/** Open leaves stay in the pane even after the sidebar row is filed in a pool. */
function tabsOnPane(groupId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

function poolTabs(sectionId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.poolSectionId === sectionId);
}

function visibleGroups() {
  return groups.filter((g) => g.dock);
}

function render() {
  renderTree();
  renderWorkspace();
}

function renderTree() {
  tree.replaceChildren();
  for (const section of sections) {
    const label = el("div", "sec-label");
    label.append(el("span", "chev", "›"), document.createTextNode(section.title));
    const owned = groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id).length;
    label.append(el("span", "count", String(owned)));
    tree.append(label);

    const tray = el("div", "pool");
    tray.dataset.sectionId = section.id;
    tray.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
    tray.addEventListener("drop", (evt) => {
      evt.preventDefault();
      const ids = takeDrag(evt);
      if (ids.length) sendToPool(ids, section.id);
    });
    tray.append(el("div", "cap", section.title + " pool"));
    const parked = poolTabs(section.id);
    if (parked.length === 0) tray.append(el("div", "empty", "Drop or send tabs here. They stay open."));
    for (const tab of parked) {
      const home = groupById(tab.origin?.groupId ?? tab.groupId);
      const row = tabRow(tab, home ? "returns to " + home.title : "");
      tray.append(row);
    }
    tree.append(tray);

    for (const group of groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id)) {
      const kids = tabsInGroup(group.id);
      const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === group.id ? " selected" : ""));
      const bar = el("span", "bar");
      bar.style.background = group.color;
      row.append(bar, el("span", "chev", "›"), el("span", "name", group.title));
      const meta = group.dock ? "on screen" : "not on screen";
      row.append(el("span", "meta", kids.length + " · " + meta));
      row.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sideSelected = group.id;
        say("Selected the " + group.title + " group. The pane stayed where it is.");
        render();
      });
      row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, groupMenu(group)));
      row.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
      row.addEventListener("drop", (evt) => {
        evt.preventDefault();
        evt.stopPropagation();
        const ids = takeDrag(evt);
        if (ids.length) sendToGroup(ids, group.id);
      });
      tree.append(row);
      for (const tab of kids) tree.append(tabRow(tab, ""));
    }
  }
}

function tabRow(tab, hint) {
  const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === tab.id ? " selected" : ""));
  row.style.paddingLeft = "28px";
  const name = el("span", "name");
  name.textContent = tab.title;
  if (hint) name.append(el("span", "home-hint", hint));
  row.append(el("span", "chev", "·"), name);
  if (tab.poolSectionId) row.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
  row.addEventListener("click", () => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    say("Selected “" + tab.title + "”. Nothing opened and nothing moved.");
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    openMenu(evt, tabMenu([tab.id], "sidebar"));
    render();
  });
  row.draggable = true;
  row.addEventListener("dragstart", (evt) => setDrag(evt, tab.id));
  return row;
}

function renderWorkspace() {
  workspace.replaceChildren();
  for (const edge of ["top", "left", "main", "right", "bottom"]) {
    const cell = el("div", "cell");
    cell.dataset.edge = edge;
    for (const group of visibleGroups().filter((g) => (g.dock || "main") === edge)) {
      cell.append(frameFor(group));
    }
    workspace.append(cell);
  }
}

function frameFor(group) {
  const frame = el("div", "frame" + (group.dock && group.dock !== "main" ? " docked" : ""));
  const bar = el("div", "tabbar");
  const strip = el("div", "tabs");
  for (const tab of tabsOnPane(group.id)) {
    const chip = el("div", "chip" + (tab.id === activeId ? " active" : "") + (selected.has(tab.id) ? " picked" : ""));
    const label = el("span", "label", tab.title);
    chip.append(label);
    if (tab.poolSectionId) chip.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
    chip.draggable = true;
    chip.addEventListener("dragstart", (evt) => setDrag(evt, tab.id));
    chip.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
      if (evt.ctrlKey || evt.metaKey) {
        if (selected.has(tab.id)) selected.delete(tab.id);
        else selected.add(tab.id);
        say(selected.size + " tabs selected. Right-click to send them. The pane stayed put.");
      } else {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
        say("Showing “" + tab.title + "” in the pane already on screen.");
      }
      render();
    });
    chip.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
      const ids = selected.has(tab.id) && selected.size > 1 ? [...selected] : [tab.id];
      if (ids.length === 1) {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
      }
      openMenu(evt, tabMenu(ids, "tab"));
      render();
    });
    strip.append(chip);
  }
  const stack = el("div", "stack-btn", "▾");
  stack.title = "Tab stack";
  stack.addEventListener("click", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  stack.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  bar.append(strip, stack);
  const doc = el("div", "doc");
  const shown = tabById(activeId);
  const inThis = shown && shown.groupId === group.id && !shown.poolSectionId;
  doc.append(el("h2", "", inThis ? shown.title : group.title));
  doc.append(el("p", "", inThis
    ? "This note is already in this pane. Selecting it here does not create a split."
    : "This pane belongs to " + group.title + "."));
  frame.append(bar, doc);
  return frame;
}

function groupMenu(group) {
  return {
    title: group.title,
    items: [
      { label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) },
      { sep: true },
      { label: "Obsidian: Close all", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own Close all.") },
    ],
  };
}

function stackMenu(group) {
  const items = tabsOnPane(group.id).map((tab) => ({
    label: tab.title,
    run: () => {
      selected = new Set([tab.id]);
      activeId = tab.id;
      say("Picked “" + tab.title + "” from the stack. The pane stayed put.");
      render();
    },
  }));
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({ label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) });
  items.push({
    label: "Send every tab to pool",
    hint: "leaves stay",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(tabsInGroup(group.id).map((t) => t.id), section.id),
    })),
  });
  return { title: "Stack · " + group.title, hint: "Dock moves every tab in this pane together.", items };
}

function tabMenu(ids, source) {
  const many = ids.length > 1;
  const first = tabById(ids[0]);
  const items = [];
  if (source === "tab") {
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Close selected" : "Obsidian: Close", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Pin selected" : "Obsidian: Pin", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ sep: true });
  }
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to pool" : "Send to pool",
    hint: "leaf stays",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(ids, section.id),
    })),
  });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to group" : "Send to group",
    hint: "no reveal",
    children: groups.filter((g) => !g.peeled).map((group) => ({
      label: group.title,
      dim: ids.every((id) => tabById(id).groupId === group.id && !tabById(id).poolSectionId),
      run: () => sendToGroup(ids, group.id),
    })),
  });
  const returnable = ids.filter((id) => tabById(id).origin);
  if (returnable.length) {
    items.push({
      label: returnable.length > 1 ? "Return each to its own group" : "Return to " + (groupById(tabById(returnable[0]).origin.groupId)?.title ?? "origin"),
      run: () => restore(returnable),
    });
  }
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Dock selected together" : "Dock this tab",
    hint: "one pane",
    children: dockItems((edge) => peel(ids, edge)),
  });
  return { title: many ? ids.length + " tabs" : first.title, hint: source === "sidebar" ? "Same commands as the tab header." : "", items };
}

function dockItems(run) {
  return [
    ["Dock left", "left"],
    ["Dock right", "right"],
    ["Dock top", "top"],
    ["Dock bottom", "bottom"],
  ].map(([label, edge]) => ({ label, run: () => run(edge) }));
}

function sendToPool(ids, sectionId) {
  const section = sectionById(sectionId);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) tab.origin = { groupId: tab.groupId, order: tab.order };
    tab.poolSectionId = sectionId;
  }
  selected = new Set(ids);
  say("Filed " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " in the " + section.title + " pool. " + (ids.length > 1 ? "They remember" : "It remembers") + " where " + (ids.length > 1 ? "they" : "it") + " came from. No pane moved.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function sendToGroup(ids, groupId) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  let order = tabsInGroup(groupId).reduce((max, tab) => Math.max(max, tab.order), -1);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (tab.groupId === groupId && !tab.poolSectionId) continue;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = groupId;
    tab.order = ++order;
    if (!group.dock) group.dock = null;
  }
  say("Sent " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " to " + group.title + ". " + (group.dock ? "That pane is on screen." : "That pane stayed off screen, and this view did not jump to it.") + " This is their new home.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function restore(ids) {
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) continue;
    tab.groupId = tab.origin.groupId;
    tab.order = tab.origin.order;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
  }
  say("Put back in the group " + (ids.length > 1 ? "each tab" : "it") + " left. The view did not jump.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function dockGroup(groupId, edge) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  group.dock = edge;
  say("Docked the " + group.title + " pane to the " + edge + ". Every tab in that pane moved together.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function peel(ids, edge) {
  const id = "peel" + seq++;
  const title = ids.length === 1 ? tabById(ids[0]).title : ids.length + " tabs";
  groups.push({ id, title, sectionId: "work", color: "#7eb6d6", dock: edge, peeled: true });
  let order = 0;
  for (const tabId of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(tabId);
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = id;
    tab.order = order++;
  }
  say("Peeled " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " into " + (ids.length > 1 ? "their" : "its") + " own pane on the " + edge + ". The rest of the group stayed.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function openMenu(evt, spec) {
  evt.preventDefault();
  evt.stopPropagation();
  menu.replaceChildren();
  if (spec.hint) menu.append(el("div", "hint", spec.hint));
  for (const item of spec.items) {
    if (item.sep) {
      menu.append(el("div", "sep"));
      continue;
    }
    const row = el("div", "mi" + (item.dim ? " dim" : ""));
    row.append(document.createTextNode(item.label));
    if (item.hint) row.append(el("span", "k", item.hint));
    if (item.children) {
      row.append(el("span", "k", "›"));
      const sub = el("div", "sub");
      for (const child of item.children) {
        const subRow = el("div", "mi" + (child.dim ? " dim" : ""), child.label);
        subRow.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (!child.dim) child.run();
        });
        sub.append(subRow);
      }
      row.append(sub);
      row.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => row.classList.add("open"));
      row.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => row.classList.remove("open"));
    } else {
      row.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        item.run();
      });
    }
    menu.append(row);
  }
  menu.classList.remove("hidden");
  const pad = 8;
  const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
  let x = evt.clientX;
  let y = evt.clientY;
  if (x + rect.width > window.innerWidth - pad) x = window.innerWidth - rect.width - pad;
  if (y + rect.height > window.innerHeight - pad) y = window.innerHeight - rect.height - pad;
  menu.style.left = x + "px";
  menu.style.top = y + "px";
}

function closeMenu() { menu.classList.add("hidden"); }

function el(tag, className, text) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (className) node.className = className;
  if (text != null) node.textContent = text;
  return node;
}

document.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
  if (!menu.contains(evt.target)) closeMenu();
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (evt) => {
  if (evt.key === "Escape") closeMenu();
});

render();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  .sep { height: 1px; background: #3a3a3a; margin: 4px 0; }
  .sub {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    left: 100%;
    top: -5px;
    min-width: 200px;
    background: var(--menu);
    border: 1px solid #3f3f3f;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
    padding: 4px 0;
  }
  .mi.open > .sub, .mi:hover > .sub { display: block; }
  .hint { padding: 2px 12px 6px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="brief">
    <h1>Working tabs wireframe</h1>
    <p>Click only selects. The tab stack docks the whole pane. A tab’s own menu sends that tab into a pool or another group. Ctrl-click several tabs, then right-click, to send them together. Right-click a sidebar row for the same send commands.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="stage">
    <div class="window">
      <aside>
        <input class="search" value="" placeholder="Search tabs and groups…" disabled />
        <div class="tree" id="tree"></div>
      </aside>
      <main>
        <div class="workspace" id="workspace"></div>
      </main>
      <div class="status" id="status">Click a tab to select it. The pane stays where it is.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="menu" class="menu hidden"></div>
<script>
const sections = [
  { id: "nav", title: "Navigation", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "work", title: "Work", color: "#e08b3c" },
];

let groups = [
  { id: "sast", title: "SAST", sectionId: "nav", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "main", title: "Main", sectionId: "nav", color: "#8b6fd6" },
  { id: "home", title: "Home", sectionId: "nav", color: "#43a047" },
  { id: "qisl", title: "QISL Platform", sectionId: "work", color: "#e08b3c", dock: "main" },
  { id: "harness", title: "Tool Harness", sectionId: "work", color: "#2fa3a3" },
  { id: "sfa", title: "SFA", sectionId: "work", color: "#4a7fe0" },
  { id: "pay", title: "Payment Gateway", sectionId: "work", color: "#d0a215" },
  { id: "ext", title: "External Services", sectionId: "work", color: "#d1453b" },
];

let tabs = [
  { id: "a", title: "Architecture and Design of a Decoupled…", groupId: "qisl", order: 0 },
  { id: "b", title: "Session Recovery — Backend Gr…", groupId: "qisl", order: 1 },
  { id: "c", title: "Belial Dreams", groupId: "qisl", order: 2 },
  { id: "d", title: "Terminus 1", groupId: "qisl", order: 3 },
  { id: "e", title: "QISL Platform", groupId: "qisl", order: 4 },
  { id: "f", title: "Payment notes", groupId: "ext", order: 0 },
  { id: "g", title: "Theme registry", groupId: "harness", order: 0 },
];

let activeId = "e";
let selected = new Set(["e"]);
let sideSelected = null;
let seq = 1;

const tree = document.getElementById("tree");
const workspace = document.getElementById("workspace");
const status = document.getElementById("status");
const menu = document.getElementById("menu");

function groupById(id) { return groups.find((g) => g.id === id); }
function sectionById(id) { return sections.find((s) => s.id === id); }
function tabById(id) { return tabs.find((t) => t.id === id); }

function say(text) { status.textContent = text; }

function tabsInGroup(groupId) {
  return tabs
    .filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId && !t.poolSectionId)
    .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

/** Open leaves stay in the pane even after the sidebar row is filed in a pool. */
function tabsOnPane(groupId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

function poolTabs(sectionId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.poolSectionId === sectionId);
}

function visibleGroups() {
  return groups.filter((g) => g.dock);
}

function render() {
  renderTree();
  renderWorkspace();
}

function renderTree() {
  tree.replaceChildren();
  for (const section of sections) {
    const label = el("div", "sec-label");
    label.append(el("span", "chev", "›"), document.createTextNode(section.title));
    const owned = groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id).length;
    label.append(el("span", "count", String(owned)));
    tree.append(label);

    const tray = el("div", "pool");
    tray.dataset.sectionId = section.id;
    tray.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
    tray.addEventListener("drop", (evt) => {
      evt.preventDefault();
      const ids = takeDrag(evt);
      if (ids.length) sendToPool(ids, section.id);
    });
    tray.append(el("div", "cap", section.title + " pool"));
    const parked = poolTabs(section.id);
    if (parked.length === 0) tray.append(el("div", "empty", "Drop or send tabs here. They stay open."));
    for (const tab of parked) {
      const home = groupById(tab.origin?.groupId ?? tab.groupId);
      const row = tabRow(tab, home ? "returns to " + home.title : "");
      tray.append(row);
    }
    tree.append(tray);

    for (const group of groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id)) {
      const kids = tabsInGroup(group.id);
      const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === group.id ? " selected" : ""));
      const bar = el("span", "bar");
      bar.style.background = group.color;
      row.append(bar, el("span", "chev", "›"), el("span", "name", group.title));
      const meta = group.dock ? "on screen" : "not on screen";
      row.append(el("span", "meta", kids.length + " · " + meta));
      row.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sideSelected = group.id;
        say("Selected the " + group.title + " group. The pane stayed where it is.");
        render();
      });
      row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, groupMenu(group)));
      row.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
      row.addEventListener("drop", (evt) => {
        evt.preventDefault();
        evt.stopPropagation();
        const ids = takeDrag(evt);
        if (ids.length) sendToGroup(ids, group.id);
      });
      tree.append(row);
      for (const tab of kids) tree.append(tabRow(tab, ""));
    }
  }
}

function tabRow(tab, hint) {
  const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === tab.id ? " selected" : ""));
  row.style.paddingLeft = "28px";
  const name = el("span", "name");
  name.textContent = tab.title;
  if (hint) name.append(el("span", "home-hint", hint));
  row.append(el("span", "chev", "·"), name);
  if (tab.poolSectionId) row.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
  row.addEventListener("click", () => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    say("Selected “" + tab.title + "”. Nothing opened and nothing moved.");
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    openMenu(evt, tabMenu([tab.id], "sidebar"));
    render();
  });
  row.draggable = true;
  row.addEventListener("dragstart", (evt) => setDrag(evt, tab.id));
  return row;
}

function renderWorkspace() {
  workspace.replaceChildren();
  for (const edge of ["top", "left", "main", "right", "bottom"]) {
    const cell = el("div", "cell");
    cell.dataset.edge = edge;
    for (const group of visibleGroups().filter((g) => (g.dock || "main") === edge)) {
      cell.append(frameFor(group));
    }
    workspace.append(cell);
  }
}

function frameFor(group) {
  const frame = el("div", "frame" + (group.dock && group.dock !== "main" ? " docked" : ""));
  const bar = el("div", "tabbar");
  const strip = el("div", "tabs");
  for (const tab of tabsOnPane(group.id)) {
    const chip = el("div", "chip" + (tab.id === activeId ? " active" : "") + (selected.has(tab.id) ? " picked" : ""));
    const label = el("span", "label", tab.title);
    chip.append(label);
    if (tab.poolSectionId) chip.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
    chip.draggable = true;
    chip.addEventListener("dragstart", (evt) => setDrag(evt, tab.id));
    chip.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
      if (evt.ctrlKey || evt.metaKey) {
        if (selected.has(tab.id)) selected.delete(tab.id);
        else selected.add(tab.id);
        say(selected.size + " tabs selected. Right-click to send them. The pane stayed put.");
      } else {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
        say("Showing “" + tab.title + "” in the pane already on screen.");
      }
      render();
    });
    chip.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
      const ids = selected.has(tab.id) && selected.size > 1 ? [...selected] : [tab.id];
      if (ids.length === 1) {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
      }
      openMenu(evt, tabMenu(ids, "tab"));
      render();
    });
    strip.append(chip);
  }
  const stack = el("div", "stack-btn", "▾");
  stack.title = "Tab stack";
  stack.addEventListener("click", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  stack.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  bar.append(strip, stack);
  const doc = el("div", "doc");
  const shown = tabById(activeId);
  const inThis = shown && shown.groupId === group.id && !shown.poolSectionId;
  doc.append(el("h2", "", inThis ? shown.title : group.title));
  doc.append(el("p", "", inThis
    ? "This note is already in this pane. Selecting it here does not create a split."
    : "This pane belongs to " + group.title + "."));
  frame.append(bar, doc);
  return frame;
}

function groupMenu(group) {
  return {
    title: group.title,
    items: [
      { label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) },
      { sep: true },
      { label: "Obsidian: Close all", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own Close all.") },
    ],
  };
}

function stackMenu(group) {
  const items = tabsOnPane(group.id).map((tab) => ({
    label: tab.title,
    run: () => {
      selected = new Set([tab.id]);
      activeId = tab.id;
      say("Picked “" + tab.title + "” from the stack. The pane stayed put.");
      render();
    },
  }));
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({ label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) });
  items.push({
    label: "Send every tab to pool",
    hint: "leaves stay",
      children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(tabsOnPane(group.id).map((t) => t.id), section.id),
    })),
  });
  return { title: "Stack · " + group.title, hint: "Dock moves every tab in this pane together.", items };
}

function tabMenu(ids, source) {
  const many = ids.length > 1;
  const first = tabById(ids[0]);
  const items = [];
  if (source === "tab") {
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Close selected" : "Obsidian: Close", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Pin selected" : "Obsidian: Pin", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ sep: true });
  }
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to pool" : "Send to pool",
    hint: "leaf stays",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(ids, section.id),
    })),
  });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to group" : "Send to group",
    hint: "no reveal",
    children: groups.filter((g) => !g.peeled).map((group) => ({
      label: group.title,
      dim: ids.every((id) => tabById(id).groupId === group.id && !tabById(id).poolSectionId),
      run: () => sendToGroup(ids, group.id),
    })),
  });
  const returnable = ids.filter((id) => tabById(id).origin);
  if (returnable.length) {
    items.push({
      label: returnable.length > 1 ? "Return each to its own group" : "Return to " + (groupById(tabById(returnable[0]).origin.groupId)?.title ?? "origin"),
      run: () => restore(returnable),
    });
  }
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Dock selected together" : "Dock this tab",
    hint: "one pane",
    children: dockItems((edge) => peel(ids, edge)),
  });
  return { title: many ? ids.length + " tabs" : first.title, hint: source === "sidebar" ? "Same commands as the tab header." : "", items };
}

function dockItems(run) {
  return [
    ["Dock left", "left"],
    ["Dock right", "right"],
    ["Dock top", "top"],
    ["Dock bottom", "bottom"],
  ].map(([label, edge]) => ({ label, run: () => run(edge) }));
}

function sendToPool(ids, sectionId) {
  const section = sectionById(sectionId);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) tab.origin = { groupId: tab.groupId, order: tab.order };
    tab.poolSectionId = sectionId;
  }
  selected = new Set(ids);
  say("Filed " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " in the " + section.title + " pool. " + (ids.length > 1 ? "They remember" : "It remembers") + " where " + (ids.length > 1 ? "they" : "it") + " came from. No pane moved.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function sendToGroup(ids, groupId) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  let order = tabsInGroup(groupId).reduce((max, tab) => Math.max(max, tab.order), -1);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (tab.groupId === groupId && !tab.poolSectionId) continue;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = groupId;
    tab.order = ++order;
    if (!group.dock) group.dock = null;
  }
  say("Sent " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " to " + group.title + ". " + (group.dock ? "That pane is on screen." : "That pane stayed off screen, and this view did not jump to it.") + " This is their new home.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function restore(ids) {
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) continue;
    tab.groupId = tab.origin.groupId;
    tab.order = tab.origin.order;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
  }
  say("Put back in the group " + (ids.length > 1 ? "each tab" : "it") + " left. The view did not jump.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function dockGroup(groupId, edge) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  group.dock = edge;
  say("Docked the " + group.title + " pane to the " + edge + ". Every tab in that pane moved together.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function peel(ids, edge) {
  const id = "peel" + seq++;
  const title = ids.length === 1 ? tabById(ids[0]).title : ids.length + " tabs";
  groups.push({ id, title, sectionId: "work", color: "#7eb6d6", dock: edge, peeled: true });
  let order = 0;
  for (const tabId of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(tabId);
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = id;
    tab.order = order++;
  }
  say("Peeled " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " into " + (ids.length > 1 ? "their" : "its") + " own pane on the " + edge + ". The rest of the group stayed.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function openMenu(evt, spec) {
  evt.preventDefault();
  evt.stopPropagation();
  menu.replaceChildren();
  if (spec.hint) menu.append(el("div", "hint", spec.hint));
  for (const item of spec.items) {
    if (item.sep) {
      menu.append(el("div", "sep"));
      continue;
    }
    const row = el("div", "mi" + (item.dim ? " dim" : ""));
    row.append(document.createTextNode(item.label));
    if (item.hint) row.append(el("span", "k", item.hint));
    if (item.children) {
      row.append(el("span", "k", "›"));
      const sub = el("div", "sub");
      for (const child of item.children) {
        const subRow = el("div", "mi" + (child.dim ? " dim" : ""), child.label);
        subRow.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (!child.dim) child.run();
        });
        sub.append(subRow);
      }
      row.append(sub);
      row.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => row.classList.add("open"));
      row.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => row.classList.remove("open"));
    } else {
      row.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        item.run();
      });
    }
    menu.append(row);
  }
  menu.classList.remove("hidden");
  const pad = 8;
  const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
  let x = evt.clientX;
  let y = evt.clientY;
  if (x + rect.width > window.innerWidth - pad) x = window.innerWidth - rect.width - pad;
  if (y + rect.height > window.innerHeight - pad) y = window.innerHeight - rect.height - pad;
  menu.style.left = x + "px";
  menu.style.top = y + "px";
}

function closeMenu() { menu.classList.add("hidden"); }

function el(tag, className, text) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (className) node.className = className;
  if (text != null) node.textContent = text;
  return node;
}

document.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
  if (!menu.contains(evt.target)) closeMenu();
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (evt) => {
  if (evt.key === "Escape") closeMenu();
});

render();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
<title>Working tabs — wireframe</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #1e1e1e;
    --sidebar: #1b1b1b;
    --pane: #262626;
    --line: #333;
    --text: #d4d4d4;
    --muted: #8a8a8a;
    --faint: #6a6a6a;
    --hover: #2a2a2a;
    --menu: #252525;
    --accent: #e08b3c;
    --select: rgba(224, 139, 60, 0.18);
    --pool: #7eb6d6;
    --font: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #111; color: var(--text); font: 13px/1.4 var(--font); }
  body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100%; }
  .brief {
    padding: 14px 22px 10px;
    color: #c8c8c8;
    max-width: 1100px;
  }
  .brief h1 { font: 600 15px/1.3 var(--font); margin: 0 0 4px; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .brief p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); max-width: 78ch; }
  .stage { flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: stretch; padding: 8px 22px 18px; }
  .window {
    width: min(1100px, 100%);
    height: min(720px, calc(100vh - 110px));
    min-height: 520px;
    background: var(--bg);
    border: 1px solid #3a3a3a;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 252px 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: 1fr 28px;
  }
  aside { background: var(--sidebar); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; }
  .search {
    margin: 10px 10px 6px;
    background: #161616;
    border: 1px solid #2e2e2e;
    color: var(--muted);
    padding: 5px 8px;
    font: inherit;
  }
  .tree { overflow: auto; padding: 4px 0 16px; }
  .sec-label {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    padding: 10px 12px 4px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .sec-label .count { margin-left: auto; color: var(--faint); }
  .row {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    padding: 3px 10px 3px 8px;
    min-height: 26px;
    cursor: default;
    position: relative;
  }
  .row:hover { background: var(--hover); }
  .row.selected { background: #2c2c2c; outline: 1px solid #3d3d3d; outline-offset: -1px; }
  .row .bar { width: 3px; align-self: stretch; border-radius: 1px; flex: none; }
  .row .name { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; flex: 1; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .row .meta { margin-left: auto; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; flex: none; }
  .chev { width: 14px; color: var(--faint); flex: none; text-align: center; }
  .pool {
    margin: 2px 8px 6px 22px;
    border: 1px dashed #3a4a55;
    background: rgba(126, 182, 214, 0.04);
  }
  .pool .cap {
    padding: 4px 8px 2px;
    color: var(--pool);
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .pool .empty { padding: 4px 8px 8px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; }
  .pool .row { padding-left: 8px; }
  .home-hint { display: block; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; }
  .mark { color: var(--pool); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; background: #141414; }
  .workspace {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 28% 1fr 28%;
    grid-template-rows: 26% 1fr 26%;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px;
  }
  .cell { min-width: 0; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .cell[data-edge="top"] { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 1; }
  .cell[data-edge="left"] { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
  .cell[data-edge="main"] { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; }
  .cell[data-edge="right"] { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 2; }
  .cell[data-edge="bottom"] { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 3; }
  .cell:empty { outline: 1px dashed #2a2a2a; }
  .frame {
    background: var(--pane);
    border: 1px solid #3a3a3a;
    min-height: 0;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1;
  }
  .frame.docked { border-color: #6a4a28; }
  .tabbar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    background: #1c1c1c;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
    min-height: 32px;
  }
  .tabs { display: flex; flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  .chip {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    padding: 0 10px;
    max-width: 180px;
    border-right: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    color: #bdbdbd;
    cursor: default;
    position: relative;
  }
  .chip .label { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .chip.active { color: #fff; background: #2a2a2a; }
  .chip.active::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px;
    background: var(--accent);
  }
  .chip.picked { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); }
  .stack-btn, .more {
    width: 28px; flex: none;
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    color: var(--muted);
    border-left: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    cursor: default;
  }
  .stack-btn:hover, .more:hover, .chip:hover { background: #2e2e2e; }
  .doc {
    padding: 18px 22px;
    overflow: auto;
    color: #c6c6c6;
  }
  .doc h2 { font: 600 18px/1.3 var(--font); margin: 0 0 8px; color: #e8e8e8; }
  .doc p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); }
  .status {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    display: flex; align-items: center;
    padding: 0 12px;
    color: #c2c2c2;
    background: #181818;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .menu {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 20;
    min-width: 220px;
    background: var(--menu);
    border: 1px solid #3f3f3f;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
    padding: 4px 0;
  }
  .menu.hidden { display: none; }
  .mi {
    padding: 4px 12px 4px 10px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    position: relative;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .mi:hover, .mi.open { background: #333; }
  .mi.dim { color: #6e6e6e; }
  .mi .k { margin-left: auto; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; padding-left: 16px; }
  .sep { height: 1px; background: #3a3a3a; margin: 4px 0; }
  .sub {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    left: 100%;
    top: -5px;
    min-width: 200px;
    background: var(--menu);
    border: 1px solid #3f3f3f;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
    padding: 4px 0;
  }
  .mi.open > .sub, .mi:hover > .sub { display: block; }
  .hint { padding: 2px 12px 6px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="brief">
    <h1>Working tabs wireframe</h1>
    <p>Click only selects. The tab stack docks the whole pane. A tab’s own menu sends that tab into a pool or another group. Ctrl-click several tabs, then right-click, to send them together. Right-click a sidebar row for the same send commands.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="stage">
    <div class="window">
      <aside>
        <input class="search" value="" placeholder="Search tabs and groups…" disabled />
        <div class="tree" id="tree"></div>
      </aside>
      <main>
        <div class="workspace" id="workspace"></div>
      </main>
      <div class="status" id="status">Click a tab to select it. The pane stays where it is.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="menu" class="menu hidden"></div>
<script>
const sections = [
  { id: "nav", title: "Navigation", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "work", title: "Work", color: "#e08b3c" },
];

let groups = [
  { id: "sast", title: "SAST", sectionId: "nav", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "main", title: "Main", sectionId: "nav", color: "#8b6fd6" },
  { id: "home", title: "Home", sectionId: "nav", color: "#43a047" },
  { id: "qisl", title: "QISL Platform", sectionId: "work", color: "#e08b3c", dock: "main" },
  { id: "harness", title: "Tool Harness", sectionId: "work", color: "#2fa3a3" },
  { id: "sfa", title: "SFA", sectionId: "work", color: "#4a7fe0" },
  { id: "pay", title: "Payment Gateway", sectionId: "work", color: "#d0a215" },
  { id: "ext", title: "External Services", sectionId: "work", color: "#d1453b" },
];

let tabs = [
  { id: "a", title: "Architecture and Design of a Decoupled…", groupId: "qisl", order: 0 },
  { id: "b", title: "Session Recovery — Backend Gr…", groupId: "qisl", order: 1 },
  { id: "c", title: "Belial Dreams", groupId: "qisl", order: 2 },
  { id: "d", title: "Terminus 1", groupId: "qisl", order: 3 },
  { id: "e", title: "QISL Platform", groupId: "qisl", order: 4 },
  { id: "f", title: "Payment notes", groupId: "ext", order: 0 },
  { id: "g", title: "Theme registry", groupId: "harness", order: 0 },
];

let activeId = "e";
let selected = new Set(["e"]);
let sideSelected = null;
let seq = 1;

const tree = document.getElementById("tree");
const workspace = document.getElementById("workspace");
const status = document.getElementById("status");
const menu = document.getElementById("menu");

function groupById(id) { return groups.find((g) => g.id === id); }
function sectionById(id) { return sections.find((s) => s.id === id); }
function tabById(id) { return tabs.find((t) => t.id === id); }

function say(text) { status.textContent = text; }

function tabsInGroup(groupId) {
  return tabs
    .filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId && !t.poolSectionId)
    .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

/** Open leaves stay in the pane even after the sidebar row is filed in a pool. */
function tabsOnPane(groupId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

function poolTabs(sectionId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.poolSectionId === sectionId);
}

function visibleGroups() {
  return groups.filter((g) => g.dock);
}

function render() {
  renderTree();
  renderWorkspace();
}

function renderTree() {
  tree.replaceChildren();
  for (const section of sections) {
    const label = el("div", "sec-label");
    label.append(el("span", "chev", "›"), document.createTextNode(section.title));
    const owned = groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id).length;
    label.append(el("span", "count", String(owned)));
    tree.append(label);

    const tray = el("div", "pool");
    tray.dataset.sectionId = section.id;
    tray.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
    tray.addEventListener("drop", (evt) => {
      evt.preventDefault();
      const ids = takeDrag(evt);
      if (ids.length) sendToPool(ids, section.id);
    });
    tray.append(el("div", "cap", section.title + " pool"));
    const parked = poolTabs(section.id);
    if (parked.length === 0) tray.append(el("div", "empty", "Drop or send tabs here. They stay open."));
    for (const tab of parked) {
      const home = groupById(tab.origin?.groupId ?? tab.groupId);
      const row = tabRow(tab, home ? "returns to " + home.title : "");
      tray.append(row);
    }
    tree.append(tray);

    for (const group of groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id)) {
      const kids = tabsInGroup(group.id);
      const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === group.id ? " selected" : ""));
      const bar = el("span", "bar");
      bar.style.background = group.color;
      row.append(bar, el("span", "chev", "›"), el("span", "name", group.title));
      const meta = group.dock ? "on screen" : "not on screen";
      row.append(el("span", "meta", kids.length + " · " + meta));
      row.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sideSelected = group.id;
        say("Selected the " + group.title + " group. The pane stayed where it is.");
        render();
      });
      row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, groupMenu(group)));
      row.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
      row.addEventListener("drop", (evt) => {
        evt.preventDefault();
        evt.stopPropagation();
        const ids = takeDrag(evt);
        if (ids.length) sendToGroup(ids, group.id);
      });
      tree.append(row);
      for (const tab of kids) tree.append(tabRow(tab, ""));
    }
  }
}

function tabRow(tab, hint) {
  const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === tab.id ? " selected" : ""));
  row.style.paddingLeft = "28px";
  const name = el("span", "name");
  name.textContent = tab.title;
  if (hint) name.append(el("span", "home-hint", hint));
  row.append(el("span", "chev", "·"), name);
  if (tab.poolSectionId) row.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
  row.addEventListener("click", () => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    say("Selected “" + tab.title + "”. Nothing opened and nothing moved.");
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    openMenu(evt, tabMenu([tab.id], "sidebar"));
    render();
  });
  row.draggable = true;
  row.addEventListener("dragstart", (evt) => setDrag(evt, tab.id));
  return row;
}

function renderWorkspace() {
  workspace.replaceChildren();
  for (const edge of ["top", "left", "main", "right", "bottom"]) {
    const cell = el("div", "cell");
    cell.dataset.edge = edge;
    for (const group of visibleGroups().filter((g) => (g.dock || "main") === edge)) {
      cell.append(frameFor(group));
    }
    workspace.append(cell);
  }
}

function frameFor(group) {
  const frame = el("div", "frame" + (group.dock && group.dock !== "main" ? " docked" : ""));
  const bar = el("div", "tabbar");
  const strip = el("div", "tabs");
  for (const tab of tabsOnPane(group.id)) {
    const chip = el("div", "chip" + (tab.id === activeId ? " active" : "") + (selected.has(tab.id) ? " picked" : ""));
    const label = el("span", "label", tab.title);
    chip.append(label);
    if (tab.poolSectionId) chip.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
    chip.draggable = true;
    chip.addEventListener("dragstart", (evt) => setDrag(evt, tab.id));
    chip.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
      if (evt.ctrlKey || evt.metaKey) {
        if (selected.has(tab.id)) selected.delete(tab.id);
        else selected.add(tab.id);
        say(selected.size + " tabs selected. Right-click to send them. The pane stayed put.");
      } else {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
        say("Showing “" + tab.title + "” in the pane already on screen.");
      }
      render();
    });
    chip.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
      const ids = selected.has(tab.id) && selected.size > 1 ? [...selected] : [tab.id];
      if (ids.length === 1) {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
      }
      openMenu(evt, tabMenu(ids, "tab"));
      render();
    });
    strip.append(chip);
  }
  const stack = el("div", "stack-btn", "▾");
  stack.title = "Tab stack";
  stack.addEventListener("click", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  stack.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  bar.append(strip, stack);
  const doc = el("div", "doc");
  const shown = tabById(activeId);
  const inThis = shown && shown.groupId === group.id && !shown.poolSectionId;
  doc.append(el("h2", "", inThis ? shown.title : group.title));
  doc.append(el("p", "", inThis
    ? "This note is already in this pane. Selecting it here does not create a split."
    : "This pane belongs to " + group.title + "."));
  frame.append(bar, doc);
  return frame;
}

function groupMenu(group) {
  return {
    title: group.title,
    items: [
      { label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) },
      { sep: true },
      { label: "Obsidian: Close all", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own Close all.") },
    ],
  };
}

function stackMenu(group) {
  const items = tabsOnPane(group.id).map((tab) => ({
    label: tab.title,
    run: () => {
      selected = new Set([tab.id]);
      activeId = tab.id;
      say("Picked “" + tab.title + "” from the stack. The pane stayed put.");
      render();
    },
  }));
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({ label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) });
  items.push({
    label: "Send every tab to pool",
    hint: "leaves stay",
      children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(tabsOnPane(group.id).map((t) => t.id), section.id),
    })),
  });
  return { title: "Stack · " + group.title, hint: "Dock moves every tab in this pane together.", items };
}

function tabMenu(ids, source) {
  const many = ids.length > 1;
  const first = tabById(ids[0]);
  const items = [];
  if (source === "tab") {
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Close selected" : "Obsidian: Close", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Pin selected" : "Obsidian: Pin", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ sep: true });
  }
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to pool" : "Send to pool",
    hint: "leaf stays",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(ids, section.id),
    })),
  });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to group" : "Send to group",
    hint: "no reveal",
    children: groups.filter((g) => !g.peeled).map((group) => ({
      label: group.title,
      dim: ids.every((id) => tabById(id).groupId === group.id && !tabById(id).poolSectionId),
      run: () => sendToGroup(ids, group.id),
    })),
  });
  const returnable = ids.filter((id) => tabById(id).origin);
  if (returnable.length) {
    items.push({
      label: returnable.length > 1 ? "Return each to its own group" : "Return to " + (groupById(tabById(returnable[0]).origin.groupId)?.title ?? "origin"),
      run: () => restore(returnable),
    });
  }
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Dock selected together" : "Dock this tab",
    hint: "one pane",
    children: dockItems((edge) => peel(ids, edge)),
  });
  return { title: many ? ids.length + " tabs" : first.title, hint: source === "sidebar" ? "Same commands as the tab header." : "", items };
}

function dockItems(run) {
  return [
    ["Dock left", "left"],
    ["Dock right", "right"],
    ["Dock top", "top"],
    ["Dock bottom", "bottom"],
  ].map(([label, edge]) => ({ label, run: () => run(edge) }));
}

function sendToPool(ids, sectionId) {
  const section = sectionById(sectionId);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) tab.origin = { groupId: tab.groupId, order: tab.order };
    tab.poolSectionId = sectionId;
  }
  selected = new Set(ids);
  say("Filed " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " in the " + section.title + " pool. " + (ids.length > 1 ? "They remember" : "It remembers") + " where " + (ids.length > 1 ? "they" : "it") + " came from. No pane moved.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function sendToGroup(ids, groupId) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  let order = tabsInGroup(groupId).reduce((max, tab) => Math.max(max, tab.order), -1);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (tab.groupId === groupId && !tab.poolSectionId) continue;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = groupId;
    tab.order = ++order;
  }
  say("Sent " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " to " + group.title + ". " + (group.dock ? "That pane is on screen." : "That pane stayed off screen, and this view did not jump to it.") + " This is their new home.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function restore(ids) {
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) continue;
    tab.groupId = tab.origin.groupId;
    tab.order = tab.origin.order;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
  }
  say("Put back in the group " + (ids.length > 1 ? "each tab" : "it") + " left. The view did not jump.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function dockGroup(groupId, edge) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  group.dock = edge;
  say("Docked the " + group.title + " pane to the " + edge + ". Every tab in that pane moved together.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function peel(ids, edge) {
  const id = "peel" + seq++;
  const title = ids.length === 1 ? tabById(ids[0]).title : ids.length + " tabs";
  groups.push({ id, title, sectionId: "work", color: "#7eb6d6", dock: edge, peeled: true });
  let order = 0;
  for (const tabId of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(tabId);
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = id;
    tab.order = order++;
  }
  say("Peeled " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " into " + (ids.length > 1 ? "their" : "its") + " own pane on the " + edge + ". The rest of the group stayed.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function openMenu(evt, spec) {
  evt.preventDefault();
  evt.stopPropagation();
  menu.replaceChildren();
  if (spec.hint) menu.append(el("div", "hint", spec.hint));
  for (const item of spec.items) {
    if (item.sep) {
      menu.append(el("div", "sep"));
      continue;
    }
    const row = el("div", "mi" + (item.dim ? " dim" : ""));
    row.append(document.createTextNode(item.label));
    if (item.hint) row.append(el("span", "k", item.hint));
    if (item.children) {
      row.append(el("span", "k", "›"));
      const sub = el("div", "sub");
      for (const child of item.children) {
        const subRow = el("div", "mi" + (child.dim ? " dim" : ""), child.label);
        subRow.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (!child.dim) child.run();
        });
        sub.append(subRow);
      }
      row.append(sub);
      row.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => row.classList.add("open"));
      row.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => row.classList.remove("open"));
    } else {
      row.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        item.run();
      });
    }
    menu.append(row);
  }
  menu.classList.remove("hidden");
  const pad = 8;
  const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
  let x = evt.clientX;
  let y = evt.clientY;
  if (x + rect.width > window.innerWidth - pad) x = window.innerWidth - rect.width - pad;
  if (y + rect.height > window.innerHeight - pad) y = window.innerHeight - rect.height - pad;
  menu.style.left = x + "px";
  menu.style.top = y + "px";
}

function closeMenu() { menu.classList.add("hidden"); }

function el(tag, className, text) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (className) node.className = className;
  if (text != null) node.textContent = text;
  return node;
}

document.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
  if (!menu.contains(evt.target)) closeMenu();
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (evt) => {
  if (evt.key === "Escape") closeMenu();
});

render();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
<title>Working tabs — wireframe</title>
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #1e1e1e;
    --sidebar: #1b1b1b;
    --pane: #262626;
    --line: #333;
    --text: #d4d4d4;
    --muted: #8a8a8a;
    --faint: #6a6a6a;
    --hover: #2a2a2a;
    --menu: #252525;
    --accent: #e08b3c;
    --select: rgba(224, 139, 60, 0.18);
    --pool: #7eb6d6;
    --font: "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #111; color: var(--text); font: 13px/1.4 var(--font); }
  body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 100%; }
  .brief {
    padding: 14px 22px 10px;
    color: #c8c8c8;
    max-width: 1100px;
  }
  .brief h1 { font: 600 15px/1.3 var(--font); margin: 0 0 4px; letter-spacing: 0; }
  .brief p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); max-width: 78ch; }
  .stage { flex: 1; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: stretch; padding: 8px 22px 18px; }
  .window {
    width: min(1100px, 100%);
    height: min(720px, calc(100vh - 110px));
    min-height: 520px;
    background: var(--bg);
    border: 1px solid #3a3a3a;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 252px 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: 1fr 28px;
  }
  aside { background: var(--sidebar); border-right: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-height: 0; }
  .search {
    margin: 10px 10px 6px;
    background: #161616;
    border: 1px solid #2e2e2e;
    color: var(--muted);
    padding: 5px 8px;
    font: inherit;
  }
  .tree { overflow: auto; padding: 4px 0 16px; }
  .sec-label {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    padding: 10px 12px 4px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .sec-label .count { margin-left: auto; color: var(--faint); }
  .row {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    padding: 3px 10px 3px 8px;
    min-height: 26px;
    cursor: default;
    position: relative;
  }
  .row:hover { background: var(--hover); }
  .row.selected { background: #2c2c2c; outline: 1px solid #3d3d3d; outline-offset: -1px; }
  .row .bar { width: 3px; align-self: stretch; border-radius: 1px; flex: none; }
  .row .name { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; flex: 1; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .row .meta { margin-left: auto; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; flex: none; }
  .chev { width: 14px; color: var(--faint); flex: none; text-align: center; }
  .pool {
    margin: 2px 8px 6px 22px;
    border: 1px dashed #3a4a55;
    background: rgba(126, 182, 214, 0.04);
  }
  .pool .cap {
    padding: 4px 8px 2px;
    color: var(--pool);
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .pool .empty { padding: 4px 8px 8px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 12px; }
  .pool .row { padding-left: 8px; }
  .home-hint { display: block; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; }
  .mark { color: var(--pool); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; background: #141414; }
  .workspace {
    flex: 1;
    min-height: 0;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 28% 1fr 28%;
    grid-template-rows: 26% 1fr 26%;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px;
  }
  .cell { min-width: 0; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .cell[data-edge="top"] { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 1; }
  .cell[data-edge="left"] { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
  .cell[data-edge="main"] { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; }
  .cell[data-edge="right"] { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 2; }
  .cell[data-edge="bottom"] { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 3; }
  .cell:empty { outline: 1px dashed #2a2a2a; }
  .frame {
    background: var(--pane);
    border: 1px solid #3a3a3a;
    min-height: 0;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1;
  }
  .frame.docked { border-color: #6a4a28; }
  .tabbar {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    background: #1c1c1c;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #333;
    min-height: 32px;
  }
  .tabs { display: flex; flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; }
  .chip {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    padding: 0 10px;
    max-width: 180px;
    border-right: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    color: #bdbdbd;
    cursor: default;
    position: relative;
  }
  .chip .label { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .chip.active { color: #fff; background: #2a2a2a; }
  .chip.active::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px;
    background: var(--accent);
  }
  .chip.picked { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); }
  .stack-btn, .more {
    width: 28px; flex: none;
    display: grid; place-items: center;
    color: var(--muted);
    border-left: 1px solid #2a2a2a;
    cursor: default;
  }
  .stack-btn:hover, .more:hover, .chip:hover { background: #2e2e2e; }
  .doc {
    padding: 18px 22px;
    overflow: auto;
    color: #c6c6c6;
  }
  .doc h2 { font: 600 18px/1.3 var(--font); margin: 0 0 8px; color: #e8e8e8; }
  .doc p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); }
  .status {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    display: flex; align-items: center;
    padding: 0 12px;
    color: #c2c2c2;
    background: #181818;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .menu {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 20;
    min-width: 220px;
    background: var(--menu);
    border: 1px solid #3f3f3f;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
    padding: 4px 0;
  }
  .menu.hidden { display: none; }
  .mi {
    padding: 4px 12px 4px 10px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    position: relative;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .mi:hover, .mi.open { background: #333; }
  .mi.dim { color: #6e6e6e; }
  .mi .k { margin-left: auto; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; padding-left: 16px; }
  .sep { height: 1px; background: #3a3a3a; margin: 4px 0; }
  .sub {
    display: none;
    position: absolute;
    left: 100%;
    top: -5px;
    min-width: 200px;
    background: var(--menu);
    border: 1px solid #3f3f3f;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
    padding: 4px 0;
  }
  .mi.open > .sub, .mi:hover > .sub { display: block; }
  .hint { padding: 2px 12px 6px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 11px; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="brief">
    <h1>Working tabs wireframe</h1>
    <p>Click only selects. The tab stack docks the whole pane. A tab’s own menu sends that tab into a pool or another group. Ctrl-click several tabs, then right-click, to send them together. Right-click a sidebar row for the same send commands.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="stage">
    <div class="window">
      <aside>
        <input class="search" value="" placeholder="Search tabs and groups…" disabled />
        <div class="tree" id="tree"></div>
      </aside>
      <main>
        <div class="workspace" id="workspace"></div>
      </main>
      <div class="status" id="status">Click a tab to select it. The pane stays where it is.</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div id="menu" class="menu hidden"></div>
<script>
const sections = [
  { id: "nav", title: "Navigation", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "work", title: "Work", color: "#e08b3c" },
];

let groups = [
  { id: "sast", title: "SAST", sectionId: "nav", color: "#d45d97" },
  { id: "main", title: "Main", sectionId: "nav", color: "#8b6fd6" },
  { id: "home", title: "Home", sectionId: "nav", color: "#43a047" },
  { id: "qisl", title: "QISL Platform", sectionId: "work", color: "#e08b3c", dock: "main" },
  { id: "harness", title: "Tool Harness", sectionId: "work", color: "#2fa3a3" },
  { id: "sfa", title: "SFA", sectionId: "work", color: "#4a7fe0" },
  { id: "pay", title: "Payment Gateway", sectionId: "work", color: "#d0a215" },
  { id: "ext", title: "External Services", sectionId: "work", color: "#d1453b" },
];

let tabs = [
  { id: "a", title: "Architecture and Design of a Decoupled…", groupId: "qisl", order: 0 },
  { id: "b", title: "Session Recovery — Backend Gr…", groupId: "qisl", order: 1 },
  { id: "c", title: "Belial Dreams", groupId: "qisl", order: 2 },
  { id: "d", title: "Terminus 1", groupId: "qisl", order: 3 },
  { id: "e", title: "QISL Platform", groupId: "qisl", order: 4 },
  { id: "f", title: "Payment notes", groupId: "ext", order: 0 },
  { id: "g", title: "Theme registry", groupId: "harness", order: 0 },
];

let activeId = "e";
let selected = new Set(["e"]);
let sideSelected = null;
let seq = 1;

const tree = document.getElementById("tree");
const workspace = document.getElementById("workspace");
const status = document.getElementById("status");
const menu = document.getElementById("menu");

function groupById(id) { return groups.find((g) => g.id === id); }
function sectionById(id) { return sections.find((s) => s.id === id); }
function tabById(id) { return tabs.find((t) => t.id === id); }

function say(text) { status.textContent = text; }

function tabsInGroup(groupId) {
  return tabs
    .filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId && !t.poolSectionId)
    .sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

/** Open leaves stay in the pane even after the sidebar row is filed in a pool. */
function tabsOnPane(groupId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.groupId === groupId).sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order);
}

function poolTabs(sectionId) {
  return tabs.filter((t) => t.poolSectionId === sectionId);
}

function visibleGroups() {
  return groups.filter((g) => g.dock);
}

function render() {
  renderTree();
  renderWorkspace();
}

function renderTree() {
  tree.replaceChildren();
  for (const section of sections) {
    const label = el("div", "sec-label");
    label.append(el("span", "chev", "›"), document.createTextNode(section.title));
    const owned = groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id).length;
    label.append(el("span", "count", String(owned)));
    tree.append(label);

    const tray = el("div", "pool");
    tray.dataset.sectionId = section.id;
    tray.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
    tray.addEventListener("drop", (evt) => {
      evt.preventDefault();
      const ids = takeDrag(evt);
      if (ids.length) sendToPool(ids, section.id);
    });
    tray.append(el("div", "cap", section.title + " pool"));
    const parked = poolTabs(section.id);
    if (parked.length === 0) tray.append(el("div", "empty", "Drop or send tabs here. They stay open."));
    for (const tab of parked) {
      const home = groupById(tab.origin?.groupId ?? tab.groupId);
      const row = tabRow(tab, home ? "returns to " + home.title : "");
      tray.append(row);
    }
    tree.append(tray);

    for (const group of groups.filter((g) => g.sectionId === section.id)) {
      const kids = tabsInGroup(group.id);
      const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === group.id ? " selected" : ""));
      const bar = el("span", "bar");
      bar.style.background = group.color;
      row.append(bar, el("span", "chev", "›"), el("span", "name", group.title));
      const meta = group.dock ? "on screen" : "not on screen";
      row.append(el("span", "meta", kids.length + " · " + meta));
      row.addEventListener("click", () => {
        sideSelected = group.id;
        say("Selected the " + group.title + " group. The pane stayed where it is.");
        render();
      });
      row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, groupMenu(group)));
      row.addEventListener("dragover", (evt) => evt.preventDefault());
      row.addEventListener("drop", (evt) => {
        evt.preventDefault();
        evt.stopPropagation();
        const ids = takeDrag(evt);
        if (ids.length) sendToGroup(ids, group.id);
      });
      tree.append(row);
      for (const tab of kids) tree.append(tabRow(tab, ""));
    }
  }
}

function tabRow(tab, hint) {
  const row = el("div", "row" + (sideSelected === tab.id ? " selected" : ""));
  row.style.paddingLeft = "28px";
  const name = el("span", "name");
  name.textContent = tab.title;
  if (hint) name.append(el("span", "home-hint", hint));
  row.append(el("span", "chev", "·"), name);
  if (tab.poolSectionId) row.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
  row.addEventListener("click", () => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    say("Selected “" + tab.title + "”. Nothing opened and nothing moved.");
    render();
  });
  row.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
    sideSelected = tab.id;
    openMenu(evt, tabMenu([tab.id], "sidebar"));
    render();
  });
  row.draggable = true;
  row.addEventListener("dragstart", (evt) => setDrag(evt, tab.id));
  return row;
}

function renderWorkspace() {
  workspace.replaceChildren();
  for (const edge of ["top", "left", "main", "right", "bottom"]) {
    const cell = el("div", "cell");
    cell.dataset.edge = edge;
    for (const group of visibleGroups().filter((g) => (g.dock || "main") === edge)) {
      cell.append(frameFor(group));
    }
    workspace.append(cell);
  }
}

function frameFor(group) {
  const frame = el("div", "frame" + (group.dock && group.dock !== "main" ? " docked" : ""));
  const bar = el("div", "tabbar");
  const strip = el("div", "tabs");
  for (const tab of tabsOnPane(group.id)) {
    const chip = el("div", "chip" + (tab.id === activeId ? " active" : "") + (selected.has(tab.id) ? " picked" : ""));
    const label = el("span", "label", tab.title);
    chip.append(label);
    if (tab.poolSectionId) chip.append(el("span", "mark", "pool"));
    chip.draggable = true;
    chip.addEventListener("dragstart", (evt) => setDrag(evt, tab.id));
    chip.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
      if (evt.ctrlKey || evt.metaKey) {
        if (selected.has(tab.id)) selected.delete(tab.id);
        else selected.add(tab.id);
        say(selected.size + " tabs selected. Right-click to send them. The pane stayed put.");
      } else {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
        say("Showing “" + tab.title + "” in the pane already on screen.");
      }
      render();
    });
    chip.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => {
      const ids = selected.has(tab.id) && selected.size > 1 ? [...selected] : [tab.id];
      if (ids.length === 1) {
        selected = new Set([tab.id]);
        activeId = tab.id;
      }
      openMenu(evt, tabMenu(ids, "tab"));
      render();
    });
    strip.append(chip);
  }
  const stack = el("div", "stack-btn", "▾");
  stack.title = "Tab stack";
  stack.addEventListener("click", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  stack.addEventListener("contextmenu", (evt) => openMenu(evt, stackMenu(group)));
  bar.append(strip, stack);
  const doc = el("div", "doc");
  const shown = tabById(activeId);
  const inThis = shown && shown.groupId === group.id && !shown.poolSectionId;
  doc.append(el("h2", "", inThis ? shown.title : group.title));
  doc.append(el("p", "", inThis
    ? "This note is already in this pane. Selecting it here does not create a split."
    : "This pane belongs to " + group.title + "."));
  frame.append(bar, doc);
  return frame;
}

function groupMenu(group) {
  return {
    title: group.title,
    items: [
      { label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) },
      { sep: true },
      { label: "Obsidian: Close all", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own Close all.") },
    ],
  };
}

function stackMenu(group) {
  const items = tabsOnPane(group.id).map((tab) => ({
    label: tab.title,
    run: () => {
      selected = new Set([tab.id]);
      activeId = tab.id;
      say("Picked “" + tab.title + "” from the stack. The pane stayed put.");
      render();
    },
  }));
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({ label: "Dock group", hint: "whole pane", children: dockItems((edge) => dockGroup(group.id, edge)) });
  items.push({
    label: "Send every tab to pool",
    hint: "leaves stay",
      children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(tabsOnPane(group.id).map((t) => t.id), section.id),
    })),
  });
  return { title: "Stack · " + group.title, hint: "Dock moves every tab in this pane together.", items };
}

function tabMenu(ids, source) {
  const many = ids.length > 1;
  const first = tabById(ids[0]);
  const items = [];
  if (source === "tab") {
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Close selected" : "Obsidian: Close", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ label: many ? "Obsidian: Pin selected" : "Obsidian: Pin", dim: true, run: () => say("Left as Obsidian’s own command.") });
    items.push({ sep: true });
  }
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to pool" : "Send to pool",
    hint: "leaf stays",
    children: sections.map((section) => ({
      label: section.title,
      run: () => sendToPool(ids, section.id),
    })),
  });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Send " + ids.length + " tabs to group" : "Send to group",
    hint: "no reveal",
    children: groups.filter((g) => !g.peeled).map((group) => ({
      label: group.title,
      dim: ids.every((id) => tabById(id).groupId === group.id && !tabById(id).poolSectionId),
      run: () => sendToGroup(ids, group.id),
    })),
  });
  const returnable = ids.filter((id) => tabById(id).origin);
  if (returnable.length) {
    items.push({
      label: returnable.length > 1 ? "Return each to its own group" : "Return to " + (groupById(tabById(returnable[0]).origin.groupId)?.title ?? "origin"),
      run: () => restore(returnable),
    });
  }
  items.push({ sep: true });
  items.push({
    label: many ? "Dock selected together" : "Dock this tab",
    hint: "one pane",
    children: dockItems((edge) => peel(ids, edge)),
  });
  return { title: many ? ids.length + " tabs" : first.title, hint: source === "sidebar" ? "Same commands as the tab header." : "", items };
}

function dockItems(run) {
  return [
    ["Dock left", "left"],
    ["Dock right", "right"],
    ["Dock top", "top"],
    ["Dock bottom", "bottom"],
  ].map(([label, edge]) => ({ label, run: () => run(edge) }));
}

function sendToPool(ids, sectionId) {
  const section = sectionById(sectionId);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) tab.origin = { groupId: tab.groupId, order: tab.order };
    tab.poolSectionId = sectionId;
  }
  selected = new Set(ids);
  say("Filed " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " in the " + section.title + " pool. " + (ids.length > 1 ? "They remember" : "It remembers") + " where " + (ids.length > 1 ? "they" : "it") + " came from. No pane moved.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function sendToGroup(ids, groupId) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  let order = tabsInGroup(groupId).reduce((max, tab) => Math.max(max, tab.order), -1);
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (tab.groupId === groupId && !tab.poolSectionId) continue;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = groupId;
    tab.order = ++order;
  }
  say("Sent " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " to " + group.title + ". " + (group.dock ? "That pane is on screen." : "That pane stayed off screen, and this view did not jump to it.") + " This is their new home.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function restore(ids) {
  for (const id of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(id);
    if (!tab.origin) continue;
    tab.groupId = tab.origin.groupId;
    tab.order = tab.origin.order;
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
  }
  say("Put back in the group " + (ids.length > 1 ? "each tab" : "it") + " left. The view did not jump.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function dockGroup(groupId, edge) {
  const group = groupById(groupId);
  group.dock = edge;
  say("Docked the " + group.title + " pane to the " + edge + ". Every tab in that pane moved together.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function peel(ids, edge) {
  const id = "peel" + seq++;
  const title = ids.length === 1 ? tabById(ids[0]).title : ids.length + " tabs";
  groups.push({ id, title, sectionId: "work", color: "#7eb6d6", dock: edge, peeled: true });
  let order = 0;
  for (const tabId of ids) {
    const tab = tabById(tabId);
    tab.poolSectionId = null;
    tab.origin = null;
    tab.groupId = id;
    tab.order = order++;
  }
  say("Peeled " + ids.length + " tab" + (ids.length > 1 ? "s" : "") + " into " + (ids.length > 1 ? "their" : "its") + " own pane on the " + edge + ". The rest of the group stayed.");
  closeMenu();
  render();
}

function openMenu(evt, spec) {
  evt.preventDefault();
  evt.stopPropagation();
  menu.replaceChildren();
  if (spec.hint) menu.append(el("div", "hint", spec.hint));
  for (const item of spec.items) {
    if (item.sep) {
      menu.append(el("div", "sep"));
      continue;
    }
    const row = el("div", "mi" + (item.dim ? " dim" : ""));
    row.append(document.createTextNode(item.label));
    if (item.hint) row.append(el("span", "k", item.hint));
    if (item.children) {
      row.append(el("span", "k", "›"));
      const sub = el("div", "sub");
      for (const child of item.children) {
        const subRow = el("div", "mi" + (child.dim ? " dim" : ""), child.label);
        subRow.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
          e.stopPropagation();
          if (!child.dim) child.run();
        });
        sub.append(subRow);
      }
      row.append(sub);
      row.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => row.classList.add("open"));
      row.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => row.classList.remove("open"));
    } else {
      row.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        item.run();
      });
    }
    menu.append(row);
  }
  menu.classList.remove("hidden");
  const pad = 8;
  const rect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
  let x = evt.clientX;
  let y = evt.clientY;
  if (x + rect.width > window.innerWidth - pad) x = window.innerWidth - rect.width - pad;
  if (y + rect.height > window.innerHeight - pad) y = window.innerHeight - rect.height - pad;
  menu.style.left = x + "px";
  menu.style.top = y + "px";
}

function closeMenu() { menu.classList.add("hidden"); }

function setDrag(evt, id) {
  const ids = selected.has(id) && selected.size > 1 ? [...selected] : [id];
  evt.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", ids.join(","));
  evt.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
}

function takeDrag(evt) {
  return (evt.dataTransfer.getData("text/plain") || "").split(",").filter((id) => tabById(id));
}

function el(tag, className, text) {
  const node = document.createElement(tag);
  if (className) node.className = className;
  if (text != null) node.textContent = text;
  return node;
}

document.addEventListener("click", (evt) => {
  if (!menu.contains(evt.target)) closeMenu();
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (evt) => {
  if (evt.key === "Escape") closeMenu();
});

render();
</script>
</body>
</html>

```
