```
	private async applyPlan(entries: PlanEntry[]): Promise<void> {
		const pendingGroups = new Map<string, string>();
		for (const entry of entries) {
			switch (entry.kind) {
				case 'claimPane':
					await this.store.setHomePane(entry.groupId, entry.paneId);
					break;
				case 'releasePane':
					await this.store.setHomePane(entry.groupId, undefined);
					break;
				case 'syncTitle':
					await this.store.syncTitle(entry.tabId, entry.title);
					break;
				case 'syncViewState':
					await this.store.syncViewState(entry.tabId, entry.viewState);
					break;
				case 'setOrder':
					await this.store.setOrder(entry.tabId, entry.order);
					break;
				case 'moveTabRecord':
					await this.store.moveTabRecord(entry.tabId, entry.toGroupId);
					break;
				case 'addTab': {
					const groupId = pendingGroups.get(entry.groupId) ?? entry.groupId;
					await this.store.addTab(groupId, entry.key, entry.title, {
						filePath: entry.path,
						viewState: entry.viewState,
					});
					break;
				}
				case 'pruneTab':
					await this.store.remove(entry.tabId);
					break;
				case 'newGroup': {
					const group = await this.store.addGroup(entry.title, entry.parentId);
					await this.store.setHomePane(group.id, entry.paneId);
					pendingGroups.set(pendingGroupId(entry.paneId), group.id);
					break;
				}
				case 'merged': {
					const receipt = {
						group: entry.fromGroup,
						tabIds: entry.tabIds,
						targetGroupId: entry.toGroupId,
						at: Date.now(),
					};
					this.receipts.unshift(receipt);
					if (this.receipts.length > 5) this.receipts.length = 5;
					const target = this.store.find(entry.toGroupId);
					this.showMergeNotice(entry.fromGroup.title, target?.title ?? 'group', receipt);
					break;
				}
				case 'removeGroup':
					await this.store.remove(entry.groupId);
					break;
			}
		}
	}

	/** The tab-group element this stored group claims, if that pane still exists. */
	paneElement(groupId: string): HTMLElement | null {
		const group = this.store.find(groupId);
		if (!group || group.type !== 'group') return null;
		const leaf = this.findLeafInPane(group.homePaneId);
		return (leaf?.view.containerEl.closest('.workspace-tabs') as HTMLElement | null) ?? null;
	}

	/** True when that pane is in the layout and has a visible box. */
	isRendered(groupId: string): boolean {
		const el = this.paneElement(groupId);
		if (!el) return false;
		const style = getComputedStyle(el);
		if (style.display === 'none' || style.visibility === 'hidden') return false;
		const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
		return rect.width >= 2 && rect.height >= 2;
	}

	/** Outline the selected group's pane. Clears any previous outline. */
	markSelectedPane(groupId: string | null): void {
		const marked = document.querySelectorAll('.workspace-tabs.working-tabs-selected-pane');
		for (let i = 0; i < marked.length; i++) {
			(marked[i] as HTMLElement).removeClass('working-tabs-selected-pane');
		}
		if (!groupId || !this.isRendered(groupId)) return;
		this.paneElement(groupId)?.addClass('working-tabs-selected-pane');
	}

	/** First leaf whose parent pane id matches, if any. */
	private findLeafInPane(paneId: string | undefined): WorkspaceLeaf | undefined {
		if (!paneId) return undefined;
		let found: WorkspaceLeaf | undefined;
		this.workspace.iterateAllLeaves((l) => {
			if (!found && getPaneId(l) === paneId) found = l;
		});
		return found;
	}

	private leavesInPane(paneId: string | undefined): WorkspaceLeaf[] {
		if (!paneId) return [];
		const out: WorkspaceLeaf[] = [];
		this.workspace.iterateAllLeaves((l) => {
			if (getPaneId(l) === paneId) out.push(l);
		});
		return out;
	}

	private findOwningGroupByPane(paneId: string | undefined, excludeId?: string): SpaceNode | undefined {
		if (!paneId) return undefined;
		return this.store.items.find(
			(n) => n.type === 'group' && n.id !== excludeId && n.homePaneId === paneId
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Ported from Vertical Tabs' own (proven, shipped-for-years) approach:
	 * toggle a class on the specific pane, then let a *declarative* CSS
	 * `:has()` selector (see styles.css) cascade the collapse up through
	 * however many nested splits are affected -- not JavaScript walking the
	 * DOM. An earlier attempt tried to replicate that cascade ourselves by
	 * recursively adjusting flex values, which occasionally corrupted the
	 * sizing of *other*, unrelated panes; CSS re-evaluating `:has()` on its
	 * own, with nothing but a class toggle from us, can't drift out of sync
	 * with the DOM the way hand-rolled JS state can.
	 */
	/** Stored hide flags. Not applied to the workspace — hiding a pane is Close. */
	isEffectivelyHidden(group: SpaceNode): boolean {
		const parent = group.parentId ? this.store.find(group.parentId) : undefined;
		const section = parent?.type === 'section' ? parent : undefined;
		return effectivelyHidden(group, section);
	}

	private firstLeafByPane(): Map<string, WorkspaceLeaf> {
		const leafByPane = new Map<string, WorkspaceLeaf>();
		this.workspace.iterateAllLeaves((leaf) => {
			const paneId = getPaneId(leaf);
			if (paneId && !leafByPane.has(paneId)) leafByPane.set(paneId, leaf);
		});
		return leafByPane;
	}

	/** Drop a leftover hide class from older builds. The stylesheet no longer hides panes. */
	private applyHiddenClass(group: SpaceNode, leaf = this.findLeafInPane(group.homePaneId)): void {
		const tabsEl = leaf?.view.containerEl.closest('.workspace-tabs') as HTMLElement | null;
		tabsEl?.removeClass('working-tabs-hidden-pane');
	}

	/**
	 * Colour coding's half of the same mechanism: reaches the group's pane the
	 * exact same way applyHiddenClass does, and sets a custom property that
	 * styles.css turns into a stripe down the pane's leading edge. Nothing but
	 * a property write from here -- the stripe itself is declarative, so it
	 * can't drift out of sync with the DOM.
	 *
	 * The edge is deliberately not the tab-header row: the "Hide tab bar"
	 * setting deletes that row outright (see styles.css), and an accent that
	 * vanishes for the people leaning hardest on this sidebar would be the
	 * wrong half of the feature to lose.
	 *
	 * Always set *or* clear, never set-only: panes get recycled between groups
	 * as they open and close, and a stripe left behind would claim a pane still
	 * belongs to a group that has since moved out of it.
	 */
	private applyAccent(group: SpaceNode, leaf = this.findLeafInPane(group.homePaneId)): void {
		const tabsEl = leaf?.view.containerEl.closest('.workspace-tabs') as HTMLElement | null;
		if (!tabsEl) return;
		const slot = this.store.effectiveColor(group);
		const next = slot ? `var(--working-tabs-color-${slot})` : '';
		// Compared before writing because refreshAccents runs on every store
		// change (which includes each reconcile tick), and the overwhelmingly
		// common case is that nothing about the colour has moved.
		if (tabsEl.style.getPropertyValue('--working-tabs-accent') === next) return;
		if (slot) {
			tabsEl.style.setProperty('--working-tabs-accent', next);
			tabsEl.addClass('working-tabs-accented');
		} else {
			tabsEl.style.removeProperty('--working-tabs-accent');
			tabsEl.removeClass('working-tabs-accented');
		}
	}

	/** Re-asserts every live group's stripe. Driven off the store's change
	 * event (see main.ts) because so many different edits change what a pane
	 * should be showing -- picking a colour, dragging a group into or out of a
	 * section, recolouring the section itself, completing a group -- and every
	 * one of them already goes through the store. */
	refreshAccents(): void {
		for (const node of this.store.items) {
			if (node.type === 'group' && node.homePaneId) this.applyAccent(node);
		}
	}

	refreshHidden(): void {
		for (const node of this.store.items) {
			if (node.type === 'group' && node.homePaneId) this.applyHiddenClass(node);
		}
	}

	async toggleGroupHidden(id: string): Promise<void> {
		await this.store.toggleHidden(id);
		const group = this.store.find(id);
		if (group) this.applyHiddenClass(group);
	}

	/** Same mechanism as toggleGroupHidden, but for every group filed under a
	 * section at once -- each group's own `hidden` flag is untouched, only
	 * the section's is flipped, and isEffectivelyHidden combines the two. */
	async toggleSectionHidden(id: string): Promise<void> {
		await this.store.toggleHidden(id);
		for (const group of this.store.children(id)) {
			if (group.type === 'group') this.applyHiddenClass(group);
		}
	}

	/** For 'split', resolves the anchor pane ourselves and calls
	 * `createLeafBySplit` explicitly instead of `getLeaf('split', direction)`
	 * -- the same public API `getLeaf` uses internally (`getLeaf('split', d)`
	 * is just `createLeafBySplit(getMostRecentLeaf(), d)` under the hood), but
	 * going through it directly is one less layer to trust, and matches the
	 * mechanism the workspace drag-and-drop feature already uses successfully. */
	/** Most recent leaf in the main editor, never a side dock or this sidebar. */
	private editorLeaf(): WorkspaceLeaf | undefined {
		const root = this.workspace.rootSplit;
		const recent = this.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf();
		if (recent && recent.getRoot() === root && recent.view.getViewType() !== VIEW_TYPE_WORKING_TABS) return recent;
		let found: WorkspaceLeaf | undefined;
		this.workspace.iterateAllLeaves((leaf) => {
			if (found) return;
			if (leaf.getRoot() !== root) return;
			if (leaf.view.getViewType() === VIEW_TYPE_WORKING_TABS) return;
			found = leaf;
		});
		return found;
	}

	/**
	 * Move already-open leaves, and open closed records, into a pane on one
	 * edge of the editor. Left and right become a full-height column. Top and
	 * bottom become a full-width band. Adapted from Tab Pane Navigator's
	 * moveActiveTab: split, then keep the live leaf instead of copying it.
	 */
	private async dockLeaves(leaves: WorkspaceLeaf[], edge: DockEdge, closed: SpaceNode[] = []): Promise<SplitNode | null> {
		const editor = this.editorLeaf();
		const anchor = editor && !leaves.includes(editor) ? editor : leaves[0] ?? editor;
		if (!anchor && closed.length === 0) return null;
		const basis = anchor ?? this.workspace.getLeaf('tab');
		const orientation = edge === 'left' || edge === 'right' ? 'vertical' : 'horizontal';
		const before = edge === 'left' || edge === 'top';
		const placeholder = this.workspace.createLeafBySplit(basis, orientation, before);
		const tabs = splitNode(placeholder.parent);
		for (const leaf of leaves) {
			if (leaf !== placeholder) this.reparentLeaf(leaf, tabs);
		}
		for (const tab of closed) {
			const leaf = this.workspace.createLeafInParent(placeholder.parent, 9999);
			await this.openTabInLeaf(leaf, tab);
		}
		if (leaves.length > 0 || closed.length > 0) placeholder.detach();
		this.hoistToEdge(tabs, edge);
		(this.workspace as unknown as { requestResize?: () => void }).requestResize?.();
		const focus = leaves[0];
		if (focus && focus.parent) this.workspace.setActiveLeaf(focus, { focus: true });
		return tabs;
	}

	private reparentLeaf(leaf: WorkspaceLeaf, tabs: SplitNode): void {
		const source = splitNode(leaf.parent);
		if (source === tabs) return;
		source.removeChild(splitNode(leaf));
		tabs.insertChild(tabs.children.length, splitNode(leaf));
	}

	/** Put a tab group on the editor root so the edge spans the whole view. */
	private hoistToEdge(tabs: SplitNode, edge: DockEdge): void {
		const root = splitNode(this.workspace.rootSplit);
		if (tabs.parent && tabs.parent !== root) tabs.parent.removeChild(tabs);
		const span = edge === 'left' || edge === 'right' ? 'vertical' : 'horizontal';
		if (root.direction === span) {
			const index = edge === 'left' || edge === 'top' ? 0 : root.children.length;
			root.insertChild(index, tabs);
			return;
		}
		let band: SplitNode | null =
			root.children.length === 1 && root.children[0].direction === span ? root.children[0] : null;
		if (!band) {
			const Split = root.constructor as new (workspace: unknown, direction: 'vertical' | 'horizontal') => SplitNode;
			band = new Split(this.workspace, span);
			const existing = root.children.slice();
			root.insertChild(0, band);
			for (const child of existing) {
				if (child === band) continue;
				child.parent?.removeChild(child);
				band.insertChild(band.children.length, child);
			}
		}
		band.insertChild(edge === 'top' || edge === 'left' ? 0 : band.children.length, tabs);
	}

	private paneIdOf(tabs: SplitNode): string | undefined {
		let id: string | undefined;
		this.workspace.iterateAllLeaves((leaf) => {
			if (!id && splitNode(leaf.parent) === tabs) id = getPaneId(leaf);
		});
		return id;
	}

	async dockTab(tab: SpaceNode, edge: DockEdge): Promise<void> {
		await this.dockTabs([tab], edge);
	}

	/** Peels these tabs into one new pane on an edge. The rest of their group stays. */
	async dockTabs(tabs: SpaceNode[], edge: DockEdge): Promise<void> {
		const moving = tabs.filter((tab) => tab.type === 'tab');
		if (moving.length === 0) return;
		const leaves: WorkspaceLeaf[] = [];
		const closed: SpaceNode[] = [];
		for (const tab of moving) {
			const open = tab.tabKey ? this.findOpenLeaf(tab.tabKey) : undefined;
			if (open) leaves.push(open);
			else closed.push(tab);
		}
		const pane = await this.dockLeaves(leaves, edge, closed);
		if (!pane) return;
		const paneId = this.paneIdOf(pane);
		const title = moving.length === 1 ? moving[0].title || this.store.nextDefaultTitle('group') : this.store.nextDefaultTitle('group');
		const group = await this.store.addGroup(title, null);
		if (paneId) await this.store.setHomePane(group.id, paneId);
		for (const tab of moving) {
			await this.store.clearOrigin(tab.id);
			await this.store.moveTabRecord(tab.id, group.id);
		}
	}

	async dockGroup(id: string, edge: DockEdge): Promise<void> {
		const group = this.store.find(id);
		if (!group || group.type !== 'group') return;
		const records = this.store.children(id).filter((tab) => (tab.viewState || tab.filePath) && !tab.done);
		const leaves: WorkspaceLeaf[] = [];
		const closed: SpaceNode[] = [];
		for (const tab of records) {
			const leaf = tab.tabKey ? this.findOpenLeaf(tab.tabKey) : undefined;
			if (leaf) leaves.push(leaf);
			else closed.push(tab);
		}
		if (group.homePaneId) {
			for (const leaf of this.leavesInPane(group.homePaneId)) {
				if (!leaves.includes(leaf)) leaves.push(leaf);
			}
		}
		if (leaves.length === 0 && closed.length === 0) return;
		const tabs = await this.dockLeaves(leaves, edge, closed);
		if (!tabs) return;
		const paneId = this.paneIdOf(tabs);
		if (paneId) await this.store.setHomePane(id, paneId);
	}

	/** Bring a group that is off screen into the middle pane. Tabs join the group already there. */
	async showGroup(id: string): Promise<void> {
		if (this.isRendered(id)) {
			await this.openGroup(id);
			return;
		}
		const center = this.editorLeaf();
		if (!center) {
			await this.openInNewGroup(id);
			return;
		}
		const tabs = splitNode(center.parent);
		const records = this.store.children(id).filter((tab) => tab.viewState || tab.filePath);
		for (const tab of records) {
			const open = tab.tabKey ? this.findOpenLeaf(tab.tabKey) : undefined;
			if (open) this.reparentLeaf(open, tabs);
			else {
				const leaf = this.workspace.createLeafInParent(center.parent, 9999);
				await this.openTabInLeaf(leaf, tab);
			}
		}
		const owner = this.findOwningGroupByPane(getPaneId(center), id);
		if (owner) {
			for (const tab of records) await this.store.moveTabRecord(tab.id, owner.id);
			if (this.store.children(id).length === 0) await this.store.remove(id);
		} else {
			const paneId = getPaneId(center);
			if (paneId) await this.store.setHomePane(id, paneId);
		}
		await this.workspace.revealLeaf(center);
	}

	/** Take the group's pane off the screen. The sidebar row stays. */
	async hideGroup(id: string): Promise<void> {
		await this.closeGroup(id);
	}

	private createLeafFor(behavior: OpenBehavior): WorkspaceLeaf {
		switch (behavior.mode) {
			case 'split': {
				const anchor = this.editorLeaf();
				if (anchor) return this.workspace.createLeafBySplit(anchor, behavior.direction ?? 'vertical');
				return this.workspace.getLeaf('split', behavior.direction ?? 'vertical');
			}
			case 'window':
				return this.workspace.getLeaf('window');
			case 'tab':
			default:
				return this.workspace.getLeaf('tab');
		}
	}

	/** Opens a brand-new, empty pane per the chosen placement -- no group
	 * record is created here at all. The next reconcile pass finds the new
	 * pane unclaimed and auto-creates + auto-names its group ("Group N"),
	 * exactly like any other pane opened by hand; this is just the sidebar's
	 * "+ New group" row shortcut for that same, already-existing path. */
	async openNewGroup(behavior: OpenBehavior): Promise<void> {
		const leaf = this.createLeafFor(behavior);
		await leaf.setViewState({ type: 'empty', active: true });
		this.workspace.setActiveLeaf(leaf, { focus: true });
	}

	/** viewState works for any view type (terminal, web viewer, canvas, notes
	 * with their scroll/mode preserved) and is preferred whenever present;
	 * plain openFile() is only a fallback for simple file tabs that don't
	 * have one captured. */
	private async openTabInLeaf(leaf: WorkspaceLeaf, tab: SpaceNode): Promise<void> {
		if (tab.viewState) {
			await leaf.setViewState({ ...(tab.viewState as ViewState), active: true });
			return;
		}
		if (!tab.filePath) return;
		const file = this.app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(tab.filePath);
		if (file instanceof TFile) await leaf.openFile(file);
	}

	/** Whether a group currently has a live pane. */
	isLive(id: string): boolean {
		const group = this.store.find(id);
		return Boolean(group?.homePaneId && this.findLeafInPane(group.homePaneId));
	}

	private findOpenLeaf(tabKey: string | undefined): WorkspaceLeaf | undefined {
		if (!tabKey) return undefined;
		let found: WorkspaceLeaf | undefined;
		this.workspace.iterateAllLeaves((l) => {
			if (!found && this.getTabIdentity(l).key === tabKey) found = l;
		});
		return found;
	}

	/** Clicking a tab in the sidebar should focus that exact tab, not just
	 * whichever one happens to already be active in its pane. Opens the whole
	 * group first if it isn't live yet (or this particular tab isn't open --
	 * e.g. it was just un-done). */
	async focusTab(tab: SpaceNode): Promise<void> {
		if (tab.type !== 'tab' || !tab.parentId) return;
		const group = this.store.find(tab.parentId);
		const paneId = group?.type === 'group' ? group.homePaneId : undefined;
		let leaf =
			paneId && tab.tabKey
				? this.leavesInPane(paneId).find((item) => this.getTabIdentity(item).key === tab.tabKey)
				: undefined;
		if (!leaf && this.isLive(tab.parentId)) {
			await this.reopenTab(tab);
			const home = this.store.find(tab.parentId);
			leaf =
				home?.type === 'group' && home.homePaneId && tab.tabKey
					? this.leavesInPane(home.homePaneId).find((item) => this.getTabIdentity(item).key === tab.tabKey)
					: undefined;
		}
		if (!leaf) return;
		await leaf.loadIfDeferred();
		this.workspace.setActiveLeaf(leaf, { focus: true });
		await this.workspace.revealLeaf(leaf);
	}

	/** Put this group's tabs into the editor's current tab group. A live group is only revealed. */
	async openInCurrentGroup(id: string): Promise<void> {
		if (this.isLive(id)) {
			await this.openGroup(id);
			return;
		}
		await this.moveGroupIntoCurrentTabGroup(id);
	}

	/** Open this group's tabs in a new pane to the right. Closes the old pane first when it is already live. */
	async openInNewGroup(id: string): Promise<void> {
		const group = this.store.find(id);
		if (!group || group.type !== 'group') return;
		if (group.homePaneId && this.findLeafInPane(group.homePaneId)) await this.closeGroup(id);
		await this.openGroup(id, { mode: 'split', direction: 'vertical' });
	}

	/** Reveals a live group. A dormant group opens only for an explicit placement
	 * (split right, split down, or a new window). Mode `'tab'` does not split. */
	async openGroup(id: string, behaviorOverride?: OpenBehavior): Promise<void> {
		const group = this.store.find(id);
		if (!group || group.type !== 'group') return;

		const focused = this.store.focusedSectionId;
		if (focused && group.parentId !== focused) {
			await this.store.setFocusedSection(null);
		}

		if (group.homePaneId) {
			const leaf = this.findLeafInPane(group.homePaneId);
			if (leaf) {
				await leaf.loadIfDeferred();
				await this.workspace.revealLeaf(leaf);
				return;
			}
		}

		const tabs = this.store.children(id).filter((t) => t.viewState || t.filePath);
		if (tabs.length === 0) return;

		const behavior = behaviorOverride ?? group.openBehavior ?? this.store.settings.defaultOpenBehavior;
		if (behavior.mode === 'tab') return;
		if (behaviorOverride && behaviorOverride.mode !== 'tab') await this.store.setOpenBehavior(id, behaviorOverride);

		const first = this.createLeafFor(behavior);

		const paneId = getPaneId(first);
		if (paneId) await this.store.setHomePane(id, paneId);

		this.openingGroups.add(id);
		try {
			await this.openTabInLeaf(first, tabs[0]);
			for (const tab of tabs.slice(1)) {
				const leaf = this.workspace.createLeafInParent(first.parent, 9999);
				await this.openTabInLeaf(leaf, tab);
			}
		} finally {
			this.openingGroups.delete(id);
		}

		await this.workspace.revealLeaf(first);
	}

	/** Insert this group's tabs into the editor's current tab group. */
	async moveGroupIntoCurrentTabGroup(sourceId: string): Promise<void> {
		const leaf = this.editorLeaf();
		const paneId = leaf ? getPaneId(leaf) : undefined;
		if (!paneId) return;
		await this.mergeGroupInto(sourceId, paneId);
	}

	/**
	 * Move records into the target group, reopen leaves in its pane, remove the
	 * source, and keep a session receipt for Undo.
	 */
	async mergeGroupInto(sourceId: string, targetPaneId: string): Promise<void> {
		const group = this.store.find(sourceId);
		if (!group || group.type !== 'group') return;
		const owner = this.findOwningGroupByPane(targetPaneId, sourceId);
		if (!owner) return;
		const targetLeaf = this.findLeafInPane(targetPaneId);
		if (!targetLeaf) return;

		const tabs = this.store.children(sourceId).filter((t) => t.viewState || t.filePath);
		if (tabs.length === 0) return;
		const tabIds = tabs.map((t) => t.id);
		const fromSnapshot: SpaceNode = { ...group };

		this.openingGroups.add(sourceId);
		this.openingGroups.add(owner.id);
		try {
			if (group.homePaneId && this.findLeafInPane(group.homePaneId)) await this.closeGroup(sourceId);
			for (const tab of tabs) {
				await this.store.moveTabRecord(tab.id, owner.id);
				const leaf = this.workspace.createLeafInParent(targetLeaf.parent, 9999);
				await this.openTabInLeaf(leaf, tab);
			}
			await this.store.remove(sourceId);
			const receipt = {
				group: fromSnapshot,
				tabIds,
				targetGroupId: owner.id,
				at: Date.now(),
			};
			this.receipts.unshift(receipt);
			if (this.receipts.length > 5) this.receipts.length = 5;
			this.showMergeNotice(fromSnapshot.title, owner.title, receipt);
		} finally {
			this.openingGroups.delete(sourceId);
			this.openingGroups.delete(owner.id);
		}
	}

	private showMergeNotice(
		fromTitle: string,
		toTitle: string,
		receipt: { group: SpaceNode; tabIds: string[]; targetGroupId: string; at: number }
	): void {
		const frag = createFragment();
		frag.appendText(`Moved "${fromTitle}" into "${toTitle}". `);
		const btn = frag.createEl('button', { text: 'Undo', cls: 'mod-cta' });
		const notice = new Notice(frag, 0);
		btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
			notice.hide();
			void this.undoMerge(receipt);
		});
	}

	receiptForTarget(groupId: string): { group: SpaceNode; tabIds: string[]; targetGroupId: string; at: number } | undefined {
		return this.receipts.find((r) => r.targetGroupId === groupId);
	}

	async undoMerge(receipt: {
		group: SpaceNode;
		tabIds: string[];
		targetGroupId: string;
		at: number;
	}): Promise<void> {
		const idx = this.receipts.indexOf(receipt);
		if (idx >= 0) this.receipts.splice(idx, 1);

		const parentOk = receipt.group.parentId ? Boolean(this.store.find(receipt.group.parentId)) : true;
		const restored: SpaceNode = {
			...receipt.group,
			parentId: parentOk ? receipt.group.parentId : null,
			homePaneId: undefined,
			homeLeafId: undefined,
		};
		await this.store.insertGroup(restored);

		const surviving = receipt.tabIds
			.map((id) => this.store.find(id))
			.filter((t): t is SpaceNode => Boolean(t && t.type === 'tab'));

		for (const tab of surviving) {
			await this.closeLiveTabOnly({ ...tab, parentId: receipt.targetGroupId });
			await this.store.moveTabRecord(tab.id, restored.id);
		}

		const targetLeaf = this.findLeafInPane(this.store.find(receipt.targetGroupId)?.homePaneId);
		if (!targetLeaf || surviving.length === 0) {
			new Notice(
				surviving.length === 0
					? `"${restored.title}" restored (no tabs left to reopen).`
					: `"${restored.title}" restored as dormant — target pane was closed.`
			);
			return;
		}

		this.openingGroups.add(restored.id);
		try {
			const first = this.workspace.createLeafBySplit(targetLeaf, 'vertical');
			const paneId = getPaneId(first);
			if (paneId) await this.store.setHomePane(restored.id, paneId);
			await this.openTabInLeaf(first, surviving[0]);
			for (const tab of surviving.slice(1)) {
				const leaf = this.workspace.createLeafInParent(first.parent, 9999);
				await this.openTabInLeaf(leaf, tab);
			}
			await this.workspace.revealLeaf(first);
		} finally {
			this.openingGroups.delete(restored.id);
		}
	}

	/** Moves a tab's record and, when the target group is live, its leaf.
	 * An open leaf is not filed onto a dormant group — that split the record from the pane. */
	async moveTab(tab: SpaceNode, toGroupId: string, index: number): Promise<void> {
		await this.sendToGroup([tab], toGroupId, index);
	}

	/** Files tabs in a section pool. Open leaves stay in the pane they are already in. */
	async sendToPool(tabs: SpaceNode[], sectionId: string): Promise<void> {
		await this.store.batch(async () => {
			for (const tab of tabs) {
				if (tab.type === 'tab') await this.store.parkInPool(tab.id, sectionId);
			}
		});
	}

	/** Sends tabs to a named group, which becomes their home. Does not reveal that pane.
	 * A dormant group receives the record and the open leaf is closed, so the view stays put. */
	async sendToGroup(tabs: SpaceNode[], groupId: string, index?: number): Promise<void> {
		const target = this.store.find(groupId);
		if (!target || target.type !== 'group') return;
		const live = Boolean(target.homePaneId && this.findLeafInPane(target.homePaneId));
		await this.store.batch(async () => {
			let at = index ?? this.store.children(groupId).filter((child) => !tabs.some((tab) => tab.id === child.id)).length;
			for (const tab of tabs) {
				if (tab.type !== 'tab') continue;
				const parent = tab.parentId ? this.store.find(tab.parentId) : undefined;
				if (parent?.type === 'group' && parent.id === groupId) {
					await this.store.moveInto(tab.id, groupId, at);
					at += 1;
					if (live) {
						const updated = this.store.find(tab.id);
						if (updated && this.findOpenLeaf(updated.tabKey)) await this.relocateLiveLeaf(updated);
					}
					continue;
				}
				await this.store.clearOrigin(tab.id);
				if (!live) this.findOpenLeaf(tab.tabKey)?.detach();
				await this.store.moveInto(tab.id, groupId, at);
				at += 1;
				if (!live) continue;
				const updated = this.store.find(tab.id);
				if (!updated) continue;
				const open = this.findOpenLeaf(updated.tabKey);
				if (open && getPaneId(open) === target.homePaneId) continue;
				if (open) await this.relocateLiveLeaf(updated);
				else await this.reopenTab(updated);
			}
		});
	}

	/** Puts pooled tabs back in the groups they left. Does not move leaves. */
	async restoreTabs(tabs: SpaceNode[]): Promise<void> {
		await this.store.batch(async () => {
			for (const tab of tabs) {
				if (tab.type === 'tab') await this.store.restoreOrigin(tab.id);
			}
		});
	}

	/** The open leaf for this tab, if it is on screen. */
	leafForTab(tab: SpaceNode): WorkspaceLeaf | undefined {
		return tab.tabKey ? this.findOpenLeaf(tab.tabKey) : undefined;
	}

	/** The group that claims the pane this leaf is open in. */
	groupForLeaf(leaf: WorkspaceLeaf): SpaceNode | undefined {
		return this.findOwningGroupByPane(getPaneId(leaf));
	}

	async moveTabToNewGroup(tab: SpaceNode, direction: 'vertical' | 'horizontal'): Promise<void> {
		if (tab.type !== 'tab' || !tab.parentId) return;
		const source = this.store.find(tab.parentId);
		const anchor =
			(source?.type === 'group' ? this.findLeafInPane(source.homePaneId) : undefined) ??
			this.findOpenLeaf(tab.tabKey) ??
			this.editorLeaf();
		if (!anchor) return;

		const group = await this.store.addGroup(this.store.nextDefaultTitle('group'), null);
		this.openingGroups.add(group.id);
		try {
			const first = this.workspace.createLeafBySplit(anchor, direction);
			const paneId = getPaneId(first);
			if (paneId) await this.store.setHomePane(group.id, paneId);
			await this.store.moveInto(tab.id, group.id, 0);
			if (this.findOpenLeaf(tab.tabKey)) {
				const updated = this.store.find(tab.id);
				if (updated) await this.relocateLiveLeaf(updated);
			} else {
				await this.openTabInLeaf(first, tab);
			}
			await this.workspace.revealLeaf(first);
		} finally {
			this.openingGroups.delete(group.id);
		}
	}

	/** Closes a group's live pane (all sibling leaves in it), without touching stored data. */
	async closeGroup(id: string): Promise<void> {
		const group = this.store.find(id);
		if (!group || group.type !== 'group' || !group.homePaneId) return;
		for (const sibling of this.leavesInPane(group.homePaneId)) sibling.detach();
		await this.store.setHomePane(id, undefined);
	}

	async completeGroup(id: string): Promise<void> {
		await this.closeGroup(id);
		await this.store.complete(id);
	}

	/** Bring this section's live tab groups forward. Does not hide anything else. */
	async revealSection(sectionId: string): Promise<void> {
		await this.store.setFocusedSection(sectionId);
		for (const child of this.store.children(sectionId)) {
			if (child.type !== 'group' || !child.homePaneId) continue;
			const leaf = this.findLeafInPane(child.homePaneId);
			if (leaf) await this.workspace.revealLeaf(leaf);
		}
	}

	isStacked(groupId: string): boolean {
		const group = this.store.find(groupId);
		const leaf = group?.type === 'group' ? this.findLeafInPane(group.homePaneId) : undefined;
		return Boolean((leaf?.parent as { isStacked?: boolean } | undefined)?.isStacked);
	}

	async toggleStacked(groupId: string): Promise<void> {
		const group = this.store.find(groupId);
		if (!group || group.type !== 'group') return;
		const leaf = this.findLeafInPane(group.homePaneId);
		const parent = leaf?.parent as { isStacked?: boolean; setStacked?: (stacked: boolean) => void } | undefined;
		if (!parent || typeof parent.setStacked !== 'function') return;
		parent.setStacked(!parent.isStacked);
	}

	/** Opens a blank tab in a live group's pane -- the sidebar's stand-in for
	 * Obsidian's native "+" button, which lives in the tab-header row the
	 * "Hide tab bar" setting hides. Not open yet -- if it's dormant in a
	 * section, use "Open" first. */
	async addBlankTab(groupId: string): Promise<void> {
		const group = this.store.find(groupId);
		if (!group || group.type !== 'group') return;
		const homeLeaf = this.findLeafInPane(group.homePaneId);
		if (!homeLeaf) return;
		const leaf = this.workspace.createLeafInParent(homeLeaf.parent, 9999);
		await leaf.setViewState({ type: 'empty', active: true });
		this.workspace.setActiveLeaf(leaf, { focus: true });
	}

	/** Detaches a tab's live leaf (if its group is live and that tab is
	 * actually open in its pane) without touching stored data -- used both by
	 * the "mark done" checkbox (keep the record, just close it) and as the
	 * first half of closeTab (which also forgets the record). */
	async closeLiveTabOnly(tab: SpaceNode): Promise<void> {
		if (tab.type !== 'tab' || !tab.tabKey) return;
		const group = tab.parentId ? this.store.find(tab.parentId) : undefined;
		if (group?.type === 'group' && group.homePaneId) {
			const matches = this.leavesInPane(group.homePaneId).filter(
				(l) => this.getTabIdentity(l).key === tab.tabKey
			);
			for (const match of matches) match.detach();
			return;
		}
		this.findOpenLeaf(tab.tabKey)?.detach();
	}

	/** How many of `tab`'s siblings (by stored order) currently have a live
	 * leaf in `groupId`'s pane -- the correct index to insert/reposition
	 * `tab` at, so it lands where it actually belongs instead of at the end. */
	private countLiveSiblingsBefore(groupId: string, tab: SpaceNode, excludeTabId?: string): number {
		const group = this.store.find(groupId);
		if (!group || group.type !== 'group' || !group.homePaneId) return 0;
		const openKeys = new Set(this.leavesInPane(group.homePaneId).map((l) => this.getTabIdentity(l).key));
		return this.store
			.children(groupId)
			.filter((s) => s.id !== excludeTabId && s.order < tab.order && s.tabKey && openKeys.has(s.tabKey))
			.length;
	}

	/** Reopens one specific tab into its group's live pane (e.g. after
	 * unchecking "done"), at the position it actually belongs among its
	 * currently-open siblings -- not just appended at the end. Does nothing
	 * if the group isn't currently live; the tab will simply show up normally
	 * next time the whole group opens. */
	async reopenTab(tab: SpaceNode): Promise<void> {
		if (tab.type !== 'tab' || !tab.parentId) return;
		const group = this.store.find(tab.parentId);
		if (group?.type !== 'group' || !group.homePaneId) return;
		const homeLeaf = this.findLeafInPane(group.homePaneId);
		if (!homeLeaf) return;
		const index = this.countLiveSiblingsBefore(group.id, tab);
		const leaf = this.workspace.createLeafInParent(homeLeaf.parent, index);
		await this.openTabInLeaf(leaf, tab);
	}

	/**
	 * Repositions a tab's already-open leaf to match where it now sits in the
	 * sidebar (after a drag-to-reorder, or a drag into a different group) --
	 * relocating it between panes too if the group it was dropped into isn't
	 * the one it was already open in.
	 *
	 * Obsidian has no public API for repositioning an already-open leaf, so
	 * this uses the same undocumented `WorkspaceParent.removeChild`/
	 * `insertChild`/`selectTabIndex` internals the Vertical Tabs plugin relies
	 * on for its own tab reordering. Guarded with an existence check so it
	 * quietly no-ops instead of throwing if a future Obsidian version removes
	 * or renames them.
	 */
	async relocateLiveLeaf(tab: SpaceNode): Promise<void> {
		if (tab.type !== 'tab' || !tab.parentId || !tab.tabKey) return;
		const group = this.store.find(tab.parentId);
		if (!group || group.type !== 'group' || !group.homePaneId) return;
		const homeLeaf = this.findLeafInPane(group.homePaneId);
		if (!homeLeaf) return;
		const targetContainer = homeLeaf.parent;

		const sourceLeaf = this.findOpenLeaf(tab.tabKey);
		if (!sourceLeaf) return;

		const index = this.countLiveSiblingsBefore(group.id, tab, tab.id);
		const source = sourceLeaf.parent as unknown as { removeChild?: (leaf: WorkspaceLeaf) => void };
		const target = targetContainer as unknown as {
			insertChild?: (index: number, leaf: WorkspaceLeaf) => void;
			selectTabIndex?: (index: number) => void;
		};
		if (typeof source.removeChild !== 'function' || typeof target.insertChild !== 'function') return;

		source.removeChild(sourceLeaf);
		target.insertChild(index, sourceLeaf);
		target.selectTabIndex?.(index);
		(this.workspace as unknown as { requestResize?: () => void }).requestResize?.();
	}

	/** Closes one specific tab: detaches its live leaf and forgets it, same as
	 * closing a browser tab. Without the detach half, "removing" a tab that's
	 * still genuinely open would just have reconcile() re-add it right back
	 * under Unsorted on the next pass. */
	async closeTab(tab: SpaceNode): Promise<void> {
		await this.closeLiveTabOnly(tab);
		await this.store.remove(tab.id);
		if (tab.parentId) await this.removeGroupIfEmpty(tab.parentId);
	}

	/** A group left with nothing at all -- no live tabs, no done ones kept on
	 * purpose -- has no reason to keep occupying the sidebar. Used after any
	 * plugin-initiated tab removal; reconcile's own step 1 handles the same
	 * cleanup for tabs closed natively in Obsidian. */
	private async removeGroupIfEmpty(groupId: string): Promise<void> {
		const group = this.store.find(groupId);
		if (group?.type === 'group' && this.store.children(groupId).length === 0) {
			await this.store.remove(groupId);
		}
	}
}
```

```
import { ItemView, Menu, Notice, WorkspaceLeaf, setIcon, setTooltip } from 'obsidian';
import type TabSpacesPlugin from '../main';
import type { TabSpacesStore } from '../store';
import type { SpaceNode, OpenBehavior, ColorSlot } from '../types';
import { VIEW_TYPE_WORKING_TABS, COMPLETED_PARENT_ID, COLOR_SLOTS, COLOR_LABELS } from '../types';
import { ConfirmCompleteModal } from '../modals/ConfirmCompleteModal';
import { GroupDescriptionModal } from '../modals/GroupDescriptionModal';
import { addSendItems } from '../pane-menus';

/** A real swatch beside each colour name in the menu -- Obsidian's MenuItem
 * takes a DocumentFragment for its title, which is the only way to get colour
 * into a menu without an icon font full of pre-tinted dots. */
function colorMenuTitle(slot: ColorSlot): DocumentFragment {
	const frag = createFragment();
	const swatch = frag.createSpan({ cls: 'working-tabs-swatch' });
	swatch.style.setProperty('--working-tabs-accent', `var(--working-tabs-color-${slot})`);
	frag.createSpan({ text: COLOR_LABELS[slot] });
	return frag;
}

type DropPosition = 'before' | 'after' | 'into';

/** True for a real text field. Checkbox/radio stay out so a focused row checkbox doesn't swallow Backspace. */
function isTextField(target: EventTarget | null): boolean {
	if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
	if (target.isContentEditable) return true;
	if (target.closest('[contenteditable="true"]')) return true;
	if (target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA') return true;
	if (target.tagName !== 'INPUT') return false;
	const type = (target as HTMLInputElement).type;
	return type !== 'checkbox' && type !== 'radio' && type !== 'button' && type !== 'submit' && type !== 'file' && type !== 'hidden' && type !== 'range';
}

const PLACEMENT_MENU: Array<{ label: string; behavior: OpenBehavior }> = [
	{ label: 'Split right', behavior: { mode: 'split', direction: 'vertical' } },
	{ label: 'Split down', behavior: { mode: 'split', direction: 'horizontal' } },
	{ label: 'Open in new window', behavior: { mode: 'window' } },
];

export class TabSpacesView extends ItemView {
	private store: TabSpacesStore;
	private treeEl!: HTMLElement;
	private draggedId: string | null = null;
	private dropMarkedEl: HTMLElement | null = null;
	private unsubscribe: (() => void) | null = null;
	private visibleOrder: string[] = [];
	private focusedId: string | null = null;
	/** Ctrl-click selection. A later Send applies to every id in here. */
	private selectedTabIds = new Set<string>();
	/** While set, store-driven re-renders are deferred so the inline rename input isn't destroyed mid-edit. */
	private renamingId: string | null = null;
	private completedCollapsed = true;
	private searchInputEl!: HTMLInputElement;
	private searchQuery = '';

	constructor(leaf: WorkspaceLeaf, private plugin: TabSpacesPlugin) {
		super(leaf);
		this.store = plugin.store;
	}

	getViewType(): string {
		return VIEW_TYPE_WORKING_TABS;
	}

	getDisplayText(): string {
		return 'Working tabs';
	}

	getIcon(): string {
		return 'layout-panel-left';
	}

	async onOpen(): Promise<void> {
		const container = this.contentEl;
		container.empty();
		container.addClass('working-tabs-view');

		// Search is the only piece of chrome left above the tree -- both
		// "create" actions live in the tree itself now, next to the rows they
		// produce -- so it's always visible rather than behind a toggle.
		this.searchInputEl = container.createEl('input', {
			cls: 'working-tabs-search-input',
			attr: { type: 'text', placeholder: 'Search tabs and groups…' },
		});
		this.searchInputEl.addEventListener('input', () => {
			this.searchQuery = this.searchInputEl.value;
			this.render();
		});
		this.searchInputEl.addEventListener('keydown', (evt) => {
			if (evt.key !== 'Escape') return;
			evt.stopPropagation();
			evt.preventDefault();
			this.clearSearch();
		});

		// Not focusable. A tabindex here becomes the keyboard target, and Backspace
		// then deletes the selected row instead of editing the note or a field.
		this.treeEl = container.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-tree' });
		this.registerRootDropZone(this.treeEl);

		this.unsubscribe = this.store.onChange(() => {
			if (this.renamingId) return;
			this.render();
		});
		this.registerEvent(
			this.app.workspace.on('active-leaf-change', (leaf) => {
				const tab = leaf && this.plugin.leafSync.findTabForLeaf(leaf);
				if (tab) void this.revealNode(tab);
			})
		);
		this.render();
	}

	/** The reverse of clicking a tab: when it becomes active in the workspace
	 * (clicked directly, or switched to via keyboard), expand whatever
	 * group/section/Completed bucket it's tucked inside so the highlighted
	 * row is actually visible, not just technically focused. */
	private async revealNode(node: SpaceNode): Promise<void> {
		let parentId = node.parentId;
		while (parentId) {
			if (parentId === COMPLETED_PARENT_ID) {
				if (this.completedCollapsed) {
					this.completedCollapsed = false;
					this.render();
				}
				break;
			}
			const parent = this.store.find(parentId);
			if (!parent) break;
			if ((parent.type === 'group' || parent.type === 'section') && parent.collapsed) {
				await this.store.toggleCollapsed(parent.id);
			}
			parentId = parent.parentId;
		}
		// Class toggle only. Measuring the row here is the forced reflow in DevTools,
		// and it lands in the same turn as the key that focused the note.
		this.highlightRow(node.id);
	}

	private clearSearch(): void {
		if (!this.searchQuery) return;
		this.searchInputEl.value = '';
		this.searchQuery = '';
		this.render();
	}

	/** A tab matches on its own title or file path; a group/section matches
	 * on its own title or if any descendant matches, so a search surfaces the
	 * container a hit lives in too. */
	private matchesQuery(node: SpaceNode, query: string): boolean {
		if (node.title.toLowerCase().includes(query)) return true;
		if (node.type === 'tab') return (node.filePath ?? '').toLowerCase().includes(query);
		return this.store.children(node.id).some((child) => this.matchesQuery(child, query));
	}

	async onClose(): Promise<void> {
		this.unsubscribe?.();
	}

	// ── Rendering ────────────────────────────────────────────

	private render(): void {
		this.contentEl.toggleClass('working-tabs-wrap-titles', this.store.settings.titleOverflow === 'wrap');
		this.treeEl.empty();
		this.visibleOrder = [];
		const query = this.searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();

		const roots = this.store.children(null).filter((n) => !query || this.matchesQuery(n, query));
		if (roots.length === 0) {
			this.treeEl.createDiv({
				cls: 'working-tabs-empty',
				text: query
					? 'No matches.'
					: 'No groups yet -- open some tabs to create one automatically.',
			});
		}
		// Sections always sit below every root-level group, so the top of the
		// panel reads as "what's live right now" -- relative order *within*
		// each type still comes from the stored order (drag-to-reorder), this
		// only separates the two types from each other. The two "+" rows sit
		// between the blocks as a pair: "New group" closes out the groups it
		// appends to, "Create a section" heads the sections block it appends
		// to, so both containers read as peers you can make from one spot.
		// While a section is focused it renders first among sections.
		const focusedSectionId = this.store.focusedSectionId;
		for (const node of roots.filter((n) => n.type === 'group')) this.renderNode(this.treeEl, node, 0, false, query);
		if (!query) {
			this.renderNewGroupRow();
			this.renderCreateSectionRow();
		}
		const sections = roots.filter((n) => n.type === 'section');
		const orderedSections = focusedSectionId
			? [
					...sections.filter((n) => n.id === focusedSectionId),
					...sections.filter((n) => n.id !== focusedSectionId),
				]
			: sections;
		for (const node of orderedSections) this.renderNode(this.treeEl, node, 0, false, query);

		this.treeEl.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-divider' });

		this.renderSyntheticSection(
			'Completed',
			COMPLETED_PARENT_ID,
			this.completedCollapsed,
			(v) => (this.completedCollapsed = v),
			query
		);
		if (this.focusedId) this.showWhetherOnScreen(this.focusedId);
	}

	private renderNode(parentEl: HTMLElement, node: SpaceNode, depth: number, isCompleted: boolean, query: string): void {
		if (node.type === 'section') this.renderSection(parentEl, node, depth, query);
		else if (node.type === 'group') this.renderGroup(parentEl, node, depth, isCompleted, query);
		else this.renderTab(parentEl, node, depth);
	}

	private renderRowShell(parentEl: HTMLElement, node: SpaceNode, depth: number, extraCls = ''): HTMLElement {
		const row = parentEl.createDiv({
			cls: `working-tabs-row ${extraCls}`.trim(),
			attr: { 'data-node-id': node.id, style: `padding-left: ${8 + depth * 16}px`, draggable: 'true' },
		});
		this.wireDrag(row, node);

		// Same custom property the pane's stripe uses, so a row and the pane it
		// stands for are literally reading the same colour -- that's the whole
		// point of the coding, and it stops the two drifting apart. Tabs
		// resolve to nothing and stay unstyled.
		const slot = this.store.effectiveColor(node);
		if (slot) {
			row.addClass('working-tabs-colored');
			row.style.setProperty('--working-tabs-accent', `var(--working-tabs-color-${slot})`);
		}

		this.visibleOrder.push(node.id);
		if (node.id === this.focusedId) row.addClass('is-focused');
		row.addEventListener('mousedown', (evt) => {
			if (evt.button !== 0 || isTextField(evt.target)) return;
			if ((evt.ctrlKey || evt.metaKey) && node.type === 'tab') {
				if (this.selectedTabIds.has(node.id)) {
					this.selectedTabIds.delete(node.id);
					row.removeClass('is-picked');
				} else {
					this.selectedTabIds.add(node.id);
					row.addClass('is-picked');
				}
				return;
			}
			if (this.selectedTabIds.size > 0) {
				this.selectedTabIds.clear();
				this.treeEl.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.is-picked').forEach((picked) => picked.removeClass('is-picked'));
			}
			this.highlightRow(node.id);
		});
		return row;
	}

	private renderSection(parentEl: HTMLElement, node: SpaceNode, depth: number, query: string): void {
		const focused = this.store.focusedSectionId === node.id;
		const somethingFocused = Boolean(this.store.focusedSectionId);
		const wrapper = parentEl.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-section' });
		const row = this.renderRowShell(
			wrapper,
			node,
			depth,
			`working-tabs-section-header${node.hidden ? ' is-hidden-pane' : ''}${focused ? ' is-focused-section' : ''}`
		);

		// Force-expanded during a search / while focused. Other sections render
		// collapsed while something is focused (stored collapsed flags untouched).
		const expanded = query ? true : focused ? true : somethingFocused ? false : !node.collapsed;
		const chevron = row.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-chevron' });
		setIcon(chevron, expanded ? 'chevron-down' : 'chevron-right');

		const textCol = row.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-text-col' });
		const title = textCol.createSpan({ cls: 'working-tabs-title' });
		title.setText(node.title);
		this.wireRename(title, node);
		if (focused) textCol.createSpan({ cls: 'working-tabs-focus-badge', text: 'focused' });
		if (node.description) {
			textCol.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-description', text: node.description });
		}

		const actions = row.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-row-actions' });
		this.makeGroupActionButton(actions, 'ellipsis-vertical', 'More', (evt) => {
			evt.stopPropagation();
			this.showSectionMenu(node, evt);
		});

		this.wireRowClick(row, () => {
			if (!query) void this.store.toggleCollapsed(node.id);
		});
		row.addEventListener('contextmenu', (evt) => {
			evt.preventDefault();
			this.showSectionMenu(node, evt);
		});

		if (expanded) {
			const childWrap = wrapper.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-children' });
			const children = this.store.children(node.id).filter((c) => !query || this.matchesQuery(c, query));
			const pooled = children.filter((child) => child.type === 'tab');
			this.renderPool(childWrap, node, pooled, query);
			for (const child of children) {
				if (child.type !== 'tab') this.renderNode(childWrap, child, depth + 1, false, query);
			}
		}
	}

	private renderPool(parentEl: HTMLElement, section: SpaceNode, tabs: SpaceNode[], query: string): void {
		if (query && tabs.length === 0) return;
		const pool = parentEl.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-pool' });
		pool.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-pool-label', text: 'Pool' });
		if (tabs.length === 0) {
			pool.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-pool-empty', text: 'Send tabs here. They stay open.' });
		}
		for (const tab of tabs) this.renderNode(pool, tab, 1, false, query);
		pool.addEventListener('dragover', (evt) => {
			const dragged = this.draggedId ? this.store.find(this.draggedId) : undefined;
			if (dragged?.type !== 'tab') return;
			evt.preventDefault();
			pool.addClass('is-drop');
		});
		pool.addEventListener('dragleave', () => pool.removeClass('is-drop'));
		pool.addEventListener('drop', (evt) => {
			pool.removeClass('is-drop');
			const dragged = this.draggedId ? this.store.find(this.draggedId) : undefined;
			if (dragged?.type !== 'tab') return;
			evt.preventDefault();
			evt.stopPropagation();
			const tabsToSend =
				this.selectedTabIds.has(dragged.id) && this.selectedTabIds.size > 1
					? this.selectedTabs()
					: [dragged];
			void this.plugin.leafSync.sendToPool(tabsToSend, section.id);
		});
	}

	private isLive(node: SpaceNode): boolean {
		return this.plugin.leafSync.isLive(node.id);
	}

	private selectedTabs(): SpaceNode[] {
		const tabs: SpaceNode[] = [];
		for (const id of this.selectedTabIds) {
			const node = this.store.find(id);
			if (node?.type === 'tab') tabs.push(node);
		}
		return tabs;
	}

	private renderGroup(parentEl: HTMLElement, node: SpaceNode, depth: number, isCompleted: boolean, query: string): void {
		const wrapper = parentEl.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-group' });
		const live = !isCompleted && this.isLive(node);
		const row = this.renderRowShell(
			wrapper,
			node,
			depth,
			`working-tabs-group-header${live ? ' is-live' : ''}${node.hidden ? ' is-hidden-pane' : ''}`
		);

		// Force-expanded during a search to reveal the match inside -- collapsed
		// state underneath is untouched and resumes once the search is cleared.
		const expanded = query ? true : !node.collapsed;
		const chevron = row.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-chevron' });
		setIcon(chevron, expanded ? 'chevron-down' : 'chevron-right');
		chevron.addEventListener('click', (evt) => {
			evt.stopPropagation();
			if (!query) void this.store.toggleCollapsed(node.id);
		});

		const textCol = row.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-text-col' });
		const titleRow = textCol.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-title-row' });
		const title = titleRow.createSpan({ cls: 'working-tabs-title' });
		title.setText(node.title);
		this.wireRename(title, node);
		const tabCount = this.store.children(node.id).length;
		titleRow.createSpan({ cls: 'working-tabs-count', text: String(tabCount) });
		titleRow.createSpan({ cls: 'working-tabs-screen-state' });
		if (node.description) {
			textCol.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-description', text: node.description });
		}

		const actions = row.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-row-actions' });
		this.makeGroupActionButton(
			actions,
			isCompleted ? 'rotate-ccw' : 'check-circle',
			isCompleted ? 'Restore' : 'Complete',
			(evt) => {
				evt.stopPropagation();
				if (isCompleted) void this.store.restore(node.id);
				else this.requestComplete(node);
			}
		);
		this.makeGroupActionButton(actions, 'ellipsis-vertical', 'More', (evt) => {
			evt.stopPropagation();
			this.showGroupMenu(node, evt, isCompleted);
		});

		this.wireRowClick(row, () => void this.store.toggleCollapsed(node.id));
		row.addEventListener('contextmenu', (evt) => {
			evt.preventDefault();
			this.showGroupMenu(node, evt, isCompleted);
		});

		if (expanded) {
			const childWrap = wrapper.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-children' });
			const children = this.store.children(node.id).filter((c) => !query || this.matchesQuery(c, query));
			for (const child of children) this.renderNode(childWrap, child, depth + 1, isCompleted, query);
		}
	}

	private makeGroupActionButton(
		parent: HTMLElement,
		icon: string,
		label: string,
		onClick: (evt: MouseEvent) => void
	): void {
		const btn = parent.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-action-btn', attr: { 'aria-label': label } });
		setIcon(btn, icon);
		btn.addEventListener('click', onClick);
	}

	private renderTab(parentEl: HTMLElement, node: SpaceNode, depth: number): void {
		const row = this.renderRowShell(
			parentEl,
			node,
			depth,
			`working-tabs-tab-row${this.selectedTabIds.has(node.id) ? ' is-picked' : ''}`
		);

		const checkbox = row.createEl('input', {
			cls: 'working-tabs-done-checkbox',
			attr: { type: 'checkbox' },
		});
		checkbox.checked = Boolean(node.done);
		checkbox.addEventListener('click', (evt) => evt.stopPropagation());
		checkbox.addEventListener('change', () => void this.handleToggleDone(node));

		const title = row.createSpan({ cls: `working-tabs-title${node.done ? ' is-done' : ''}` });
		title.setText(node.title);
		this.wireRename(title, node);
		const parent = node.parentId ? this.store.find(node.parentId) : undefined;
		if (parent?.type === 'section' && node.originGroupId) {
			const home = this.store.find(node.originGroupId);
			if (home) row.createSpan({ cls: 'working-tabs-origin', text: `returns to ${home.title}` });
		}

		const actions = row.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-row-actions' });
		this.makeGroupActionButton(actions, 'x', 'Close tab', (evt) => {
			evt.stopPropagation();
			void this.plugin.leafSync.closeTab(node);
		});

		row.addEventListener('contextmenu', (evt) => {
			evt.preventDefault();
			const tabs =
				this.selectedTabIds.has(node.id) && this.selectedTabIds.size > 1 ? this.selectedTabs() : [node];
			this.showTabMenu(tabs, evt);
		});
	}

	/** A group is never created directly -- it's just whatever reconcile
	 * finds occupying a pane it doesn't already know about (see
	 * doReconcile's step 4 and LeafSync.openNewGroup) -- so this row doesn't
	 * create a group record either. It only opens a blank pane per the
	 * chosen placement and lets that same auto-detection name it. */
	private renderNewGroupRow(): void {
		const row = this.treeEl.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-row working-tabs-new-group-row' });
		const icon = row.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-chevron' });
		setIcon(icon, 'plus');
		row.createSpan({ cls: 'working-tabs-title', text: 'New group' });
		row.addEventListener('click', (evt) => {
			const menu = new Menu();
			for (const { label, behavior } of PLACEMENT_MENU) {
				menu.addItem((item) => item.setTitle(label).onClick(() => void this.plugin.leafSync.openNewGroup(behavior)));
			}
			menu.showAtMouseEvent(evt);
		});
	}

	/** Heads the sections block, paired with "New group" above it. The info
	 * icon is the only explanation of what a section is *for*, so it rides
	 * along on the row (revealed on hover) rather than staying in the chrome. */
	private renderCreateSectionRow(): void {
		const row = this.treeEl.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-row working-tabs-create-section-row' });
		const icon = row.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-chevron' });
		setIcon(icon, 'plus');
		row.createSpan({ cls: 'working-tabs-title', text: 'Create a section' });
		const info = row.createSpan({ cls: 'working-tabs-info-icon' });
		setIcon(info, 'info');
		setTooltip(
			info,
			'Organize related groups together, e.g. by sprint or timeframe. Hide a section to tuck away every group inside it at once.',
			{ placement: 'top' }
		);
		row.addEventListener('click', () => void this.createSection());
	}

	// ── Synthetic Completed section ──────────────────────────

	private renderSyntheticSection(
		title: string,
		sentinelId: string,
		collapsed: boolean,
		setCollapsed: (v: boolean) => void,
		query: string
	): void {
		const wrapper = this.treeEl.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-section working-tabs-synthetic-section' });
		const row = wrapper.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-row working-tabs-section-header' });

		const expanded = query ? true : !collapsed;
		const chevron = row.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-chevron' });
		setIcon(chevron, expanded ? 'chevron-down' : 'chevron-right');

		const titleEl = row.createSpan({ cls: 'working-tabs-title working-tabs-synthetic-title' });
		titleEl.setText(title);

		const allChildren = this.store.children(sentinelId);
		const children = allChildren.filter((c) => !query || this.matchesQuery(c, query));
		row.createSpan({ cls: 'working-tabs-count', text: String(query ? children.length : allChildren.length) });

		row.addEventListener('click', () => {
			if (query) return;
			setCollapsed(!collapsed);
			this.render();
		});

		this.registerSentinelDropZone(row, sentinelId);

		if (expanded) {
			const childWrap = wrapper.createDiv({ cls: 'working-tabs-children' });
			const isCompletedSection = sentinelId === COMPLETED_PARENT_ID;
			for (const child of children) this.renderNode(childWrap, child, 1, isCompletedSection, query);
		}
	}

	// ── Complete / restore ──────────────────────────────────

	/** Marking a tab done closes its live view (it disappears, same as the
	 * tab itself closing); unchecking it reopens that view in its group's
	 * pane. Checking off the last remaining tab in a group finishes the group
	 * too -- no extra confirm dialog, since checking every box one by one is
	 * already a deliberate multi-step action. */
	private async handleToggleDone(tab: SpaceNode): Promise<void> {
		await this.store.toggleDone(tab.id);
		if (tab.done) {
			await this.plugin.leafSync.closeLiveTabOnly(tab);
		} else {
			await this.plugin.leafSync.reopenTab(tab);
		}
		if (!tab.parentId) return;
		const group = this.store.find(tab.parentId);
		if (!group || group.type !== 'group' || group.parentId === COMPLETED_PARENT_ID) return;
		const siblings = this.store.children(group.id);
		if (siblings.length > 0 && siblings.every((s) => s.done)) {
			await this.plugin.leafSync.completeGroup(group.id);
		}
	}

	private requestComplete(node: SpaceNode): void {
		if (!this.store.settings.confirmBeforeComplete) {
			void this.plugin.leafSync.completeGroup(node.id);
			return;
		}
		new ConfirmCompleteModal(this.app, node.title, (dontAskAgain) => {
			if (dontAskAgain) void this.store.updateSettings({ confirmBeforeComplete: false });
			void this.plugin.leafSync.completeGroup(node.id);
		}).open();
	}

	/** Deleting a live group/tab record alone doesn't close its actual pane --
	 * the leaf stays open, unclaimed, and the very next reconcile pass just
	 * spins up a brand-new group for it, making the deleted row "reappear".
	 * Detaching the live leaf(s) first, same as Close group/Close tab, avoids
	 * that entirely. Sections have no live pane of their own, so this is a
	 * no-op for them beyond the plain removal. */
	private async deleteNode(node: SpaceNode): Promise<void> {
		if (node.type === 'tab') {
			// closeTab also removes the group itself if this was its last tab.
			await this.plugin.leafSync.closeTab(node);
			return;
		}
		if (node.type === 'group') await this.plugin.leafSync.closeGroup(node.id);
		await this.store.remove(node.id);
	}

	// ── Keyboard navigation ──────────────────────────────────

	/** Highlight only. No layout read, so it cannot force a reflow under the caret. */
	private highlightRow(id: string): void {
		const prevId = this.focusedId;
		this.focusedId = id;
		if (prevId && prevId !== id) {
			this.treeEl.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-node-id="${prevId}"]`)?.removeClass('is-focused');
		}
		this.treeEl.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-node-id="${id}"]`)?.addClass('is-focused');
	}

	/** On the selected group, say if its pane is actually visible, and outline that pane. */
	private showWhetherOnScreen(id: string | null): void {
		const labels = this.treeEl.querySelectorAll('.working-tabs-screen-state');
		for (let i = 0; i < labels.length; i++) {
			const label = labels[i] as HTMLElement;
			label.setText('');
			label.removeAttribute('data-state');
		}
		const node = id ? this.store.find(id) : undefined;
		if (!node || node.type !== 'group') {
			this.plugin.leafSync.markSelectedPane(null);
			return;
		}
		const onScreen = this.plugin.leafSync.isRendered(node.id);
		const label = this.treeEl.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
			`[data-node-id="${node.id}"] .working-tabs-screen-state`
		);
		if (label) {
			label.setText(onScreen ? 'on screen' : 'not on screen');
			label.setAttribute('data-state', onScreen ? 'on' : 'off');
		}
		this.plugin.leafSync.markSelectedPane(onScreen ? node.id : null);
	}

	/** A second click in a double-click is the rename, so it does not also toggle. */
	private wireRowClick(row: HTMLElement, action: () => void): void {
		row.addEventListener('click', (evt) => {
			if (evt.detail > 1) return;
			action();
		});
	}

	// ── Inline rename ────────────────────────────────────────

	private wireRename(title: HTMLElement, node: SpaceNode): void {
		title.addEventListener('dblclick', (evt) => {
			evt.stopPropagation();
			this.startRename(title, node);
		});
	}

	private startRename(title: HTMLElement, node: SpaceNode): void {
		if (this.renamingId) return;
		this.renamingId = node.id;

		const parent = title.parentElement as HTMLElement;
		const input = parent.createEl('input', { cls: 'working-tabs-rename-input' });
		input.type = 'text';
		input.value = node.title;
		parent.insertBefore(input, title);
		title.remove();
		input.focus();
		input.select();

		const finish = async (commit: boolean) => {
			if (this.renamingId !== node.id) return;
			input.removeEventListener('blur', onBlur);
			input.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);
			this.renamingId = null;
			const value = input.value.trim();
			if (commit && value && value !== node.title) {
				await this.store.rename(node.id, value);
			} else {
				input.replaceWith(title);
				// Catch up on any store changes deferred while the input was open.
				this.render();
			}
		};
		const onBlur = () => void finish(true);
		const onKeydown = (evt: KeyboardEvent) => {
			if (evt.key !== 'Enter' && evt.key !== 'Escape') return;
			evt.stopPropagation();
			evt.preventDefault();
			void finish(evt.key === 'Enter');
		};
		input.addEventListener('blur', onBlur);
		input.addEventListener('keydown', onKeydown);
	}

	// ── Create ───────────────────────────────────────────────

	/** No naming modal -- creates instantly with a placeholder title and drops
	 * straight into inline rename, since typing a name up front is more
	 * friction than the action deserves. Rename (or add a description) later
	 * from the row itself if the default doesn't stick. */
	private async createSection(): Promise<void> {
		const section = await this.store.addSection(this.store.nextDefaultTitle('section'));
		const titleEl = this.treeEl.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-node-id="${section.id}"] .working-tabs-title`);
		if (titleEl) this.startRename(titleEl, section);
	}

	// ── Context menus ────────────────────────────────────────

	/**
	 * Opened from the "Colour" item on a group or section menu. A second Menu
	 * rather than a submenu: `MenuItem.setSubmenu` isn't in the public API for
	 * the versions this plugin supports, and reaching past the typings for a
	 * nested menu isn't worth it when reopening at the same point costs one
	 * click and can't break.
	 */
	private showColorMenu(node: SpaceNode, evt: MouseEvent): void {
		const menu = new Menu();
		// Forced onto Obsidian's own DOM menu. Desktop defaults to letting the
		// OS draw menus, and a native menu item can only carry plain text -- the
		// swatch element in each title is silently dropped, leaving a list of
		// colour names with no colour in it. This is the one menu in the plugin
		// whose whole point is the rendering, so it opts out; every other menu
		// is left native and matches the rest of the app. No-op on mobile, where
		// menus are always DOM anyway.
		menu.setUseNativeMenu(false);
		const parent = node.parentId ? this.store.find(node.parentId) : undefined;
		const inSection = node.type === 'group' && parent?.type === 'section';

		for (const slot of COLOR_SLOTS) {
			menu.addItem((item) =>
				item
					.setTitle(colorMenuTitle(slot))
					.setChecked(node.color === slot)
					.onClick(() => void this.store.setColor(node.id, slot))
			);
		}

		menu.addSeparator();
		menu.addItem((item) =>
			item
				// Wording follows what clearing actually falls back to, since
				// "Automatic" would be a lie for a group that's about to start
				// tracking its section instead.
				.setTitle(inSection ? 'Use section colour' : 'Automatic')
				.setIcon('rotate-ccw')
				.setChecked(!node.color)
				.onClick(() => void this.store.setColor(node.id, undefined))
		);
		menu.addItem((item) =>
			item
				.setTitle('No colour')
				.setIcon('ban')
				.setChecked(node.color === 'none')
				.onClick(() => void this.store.setColor(node.id, 'none'))
		);

		if (node.type === 'section' && this.store.children(node.id).some((child) => child.color)) {
			menu.addItem((item) =>
				item
					.setTitle('Reset group colours')
					.setIcon('paintbrush')
					.onClick(() => void this.store.clearChildColors(node.id))
			);
		}

		menu.showAtMouseEvent(evt);
	}

	private showSectionMenu(node: SpaceNode, evt: MouseEvent): void {
		const menu = new Menu();
		const focused = this.store.focusedSectionId === node.id;
		menu.addItem((item) =>
			item.setTitle(focused ? 'Unfocus' : 'Focus').setIcon('crosshair').onClick(() => {
				if (focused) void this.store.setFocusedSection(null);
				else void this.plugin.leafSync.revealSection(node.id);
			})
		);
		menu.addItem((item) =>
			item.setTitle('Close all').setIcon('x').onClick(() => {
				for (const child of this.store.children(node.id)) {
					if (child.type === 'group' && this.plugin.leafSync.isLive(child.id)) {
						void this.plugin.leafSync.closeGroup(child.id);
					}
				}
			})
		);
		menu.addSeparator();
		menu.addItem((item) =>
			item.setTitle('Rename').setIcon('pencil').onClick(() => {
				const titleEl = this.treeEl.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-node-id="${node.id}"] .working-tabs-title`);
				if (titleEl) this.startRename(titleEl, node);
			})
		);
		menu.addItem((item) =>
			item.setTitle('Edit description').setIcon('align-left').onClick(() => {
				new GroupDescriptionModal(
					this.app,
					'Section description',
					'What this section is for…',
					node.description ?? '',
					(description) => {
						void this.store.setDescription(node.id, description || undefined);
					}
				).open();
			})
		);
		// Hidden while colour coding is switched off globally -- a picker whose
		// every choice is invisible is worse than no picker.
		if (this.store.settings.colorCoding) {
			menu.addItem((item) =>
				item.setTitle('Colour').setIcon('palette').onClick(() => this.showColorMenu(node, evt))
			);
		}
		menu.addSeparator();
		menu.addItem((item) =>
			item.setTitle('Delete section').setIcon('trash').onClick(() => {
				if (this.store.children(node.id).length > 0) {
					new Notice("Move or complete this section's groups first.");
					return;
				}
				void this.store.remove(node.id);
			})
		);
		menu.showAtMouseEvent(evt);
	}

	private addDockItems(menu: Menu, dock: (edge: 'left' | 'right' | 'top' | 'bottom') => void): void {
		const items = [
			['Dock left', 'left', 'panel-left'],
			['Dock right', 'right', 'panel-right'],
			['Dock top', 'top', 'panel-top'],
			['Dock bottom', 'bottom', 'panel-bottom'],
		] as const;
		for (const [title, edge, icon] of items) {
			menu.addItem((item) => item.setTitle(title).setIcon(icon).onClick(() => dock(edge)));
		}
	}

	private showGroupMenu(node: SpaceNode, evt: MouseEvent, isCompleted: boolean): void {
		const menu = new Menu();
		if (!isCompleted) {
			if (this.plugin.leafSync.isRendered(node.id)) {
				menu.addItem((item) =>
					item.setTitle('Hide').setIcon('eye-off').onClick(() => void this.plugin.leafSync.hideGroup(node.id))
				);
			} else {
				menu.addItem((item) =>
					item.setTitle('Show').setIcon('eye').onClick(() => void this.plugin.leafSync.showGroup(node.id))
				);
			}
			this.addDockItems(menu, (edge) => void this.plugin.leafSync.dockGroup(node.id, edge));
			menu.addSeparator();
			menu.addItem((item) =>
				item.setTitle('New tab').setIcon('plus').onClick(() => void this.plugin.leafSync.addBlankTab(node.id))
			);
			if (this.plugin.leafSync.isLive(node.id)) {
				const stacked = this.plugin.leafSync.isStacked(node.id);
				menu.addItem((item) =>
					item
						.setTitle(stacked ? 'Unstack tabs' : 'Stack tabs')
						.setIcon('layers')
						.onClick(() => void this.plugin.leafSync.toggleStacked(node.id))
				);
				menu.addItem((item) =>
					item.setTitle('Close group').setIcon('x').onClick(() => void this.plugin.leafSync.closeGroup(node.id))
				);
			}
			const undoReceipt = this.plugin.leafSync.receiptForTarget(node.id);
			if (undoReceipt) {
				menu.addItem((item) =>
					item
						.setTitle('Undo last merge')
						.setIcon('undo')
						.onClick(() => void this.plugin.leafSync.undoMerge(undoReceipt))
				);
			}
		}
		menu.addSeparator();
		menu.addItem((item) =>
			item.setTitle('Rename').setIcon('pencil').onClick(() => {
				const titleEl = this.treeEl.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-node-id="${node.id}"] .working-tabs-title`);
				if (titleEl) this.startRename(titleEl, node);
			})
		);
		menu.addItem((item) =>
			item.setTitle('Edit description').setIcon('align-left').onClick(() => {
				new GroupDescriptionModal(
					this.app,
					'Group description',
					'What this group is for…',
					node.description ?? '',
					(description) => {
						void this.store.setDescription(node.id, description || undefined);
					}
				).open();
			})
		);
		// Hidden while colour coding is switched off globally -- a picker whose
		// every choice is invisible is worse than no picker.
		if (this.store.settings.colorCoding) {
			menu.addItem((item) =>
				item.setTitle('Colour').setIcon('palette').onClick(() => this.showColorMenu(node, evt))
			);
		}
		menu.addSeparator();
		menu.addItem((item) =>
			item.setTitle('Delete permanently').setIcon('trash').onClick(() => void this.deleteNode(node))
		);
		menu.showAtMouseEvent(evt);
	}

	private showTabMenu(tabs: SpaceNode[], evt: MouseEvent): void {
		const menu = new Menu();
		if (tabs.length === 1) {
			const node = tabs[0];
			menu.addItem((item) =>
				item
					.setTitle(node.done ? 'Mark not done' : 'Mark done')
					.setIcon('check')
					.onClick(() => void this.store.toggleDone(node.id))
			);
			menu.addSeparator();
		}
		addSendItems(menu, this.plugin, tabs, { dockGroup: true, dockTab: true });
		if (tabs.length === 1) {
			menu.addSeparator();
			menu.addItem((item) =>
				item.setTitle('Close tab').setIcon('x').onClick(() => void this.plugin.leafSync.closeTab(tabs[0]))
			);
		}
		menu.showAtMouseEvent(evt);
	}

	// ── Drag and drop ────────────────────────────────────────

	/** What kind of node is allowed to end up parented at `parentId` (a real group/section id, a sentinel, or null for root). */
	private canDropAt(dragged: SpaceNode, parentId: string | null): boolean {
		if (parentId === null) return dragged.type === 'group' || dragged.type === 'section';
		if (parentId === COMPLETED_PARENT_ID) return dragged.type === 'group';
		const parent = this.store.find(parentId);
		if (parent?.type === 'section') return dragged.type === 'group' || dragged.type === 'tab';
		if (parent?.type === 'group') return dragged.type === 'tab';
		return false;
	}

	private wireDrag(row: HTMLElement, node: SpaceNode): void {
		row.addEventListener('dragstart', (evt) => {
			this.draggedId = node.id;
			row.addClass('working-tabs-dragging');
			evt.dataTransfer?.setData('text/plain', node.id);
			evt.dataTransfer!.effectAllowed = 'move';
		});
		row.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
			row.removeClass('working-tabs-dragging');
			this.clearDropMarker();
			this.draggedId = null;
		});

		row.addEventListener('dragover', (evt) => {
			if (!this.draggedId || this.draggedId === node.id) return;
			const dragged = this.store.find(this.draggedId);
			if (!dragged) return;
			const position = this.computeDropPosition(row, node, dragged, evt);
			if (!position) return;
			evt.preventDefault();
			this.markDropTarget(row, position);
		});
		row.addEventListener('dragleave', () => this.clearDropMarker());
		row.addEventListener('drop', (evt) => {
			if (!this.draggedId || this.draggedId === node.id) return;
			const dragged = this.store.find(this.draggedId);
			if (!dragged) return;
			const position = this.computeDropPosition(row, node, dragged, evt);
			if (!position) return;
			evt.preventDefault();
			void this.handleDrop(dragged, node, position);
			this.clearDropMarker();
		});
	}

	/** Returns null when this drop wouldn't be valid, so callers can skip preventDefault/marking entirely. */
	private computeDropPosition(row: HTMLElement, target: SpaceNode, dragged: SpaceNode, evt: DragEvent): DropPosition | null {
		if (dragged.type === 'tab' && (target.type === 'group' || target.type === 'section')) {
			return this.canDropAt(dragged, target.id) ? 'into' : null;
		}
		const rect = row.getBoundingClientRect();
		const fraction = (evt.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height;
		const canNestInto = (target.type === 'group' || target.type === 'section') && this.canDropAt(dragged, target.id);
		if (canNestInto && fraction > 0.25 && fraction < 0.75) return 'into';
		if (!this.canDropAt(dragged, target.parentId)) return canNestInto ? 'into' : null;
		return fraction < 0.5 ? 'before' : 'after';
	}

	private markDropTarget(row: HTMLElement, position: DropPosition): void {
		if (this.dropMarkedEl && this.dropMarkedEl !== row) this.clearDropMarker();
		row.removeClass('working-tabs-drop-before', 'working-tabs-drop-after', 'working-tabs-drop-into');
		row.addClass(`working-tabs-drop-${position}`);
		this.dropMarkedEl = row;
	}

	private clearDropMarker(): void {
		this.dropMarkedEl?.removeClass('working-tabs-drop-before', 'working-tabs-drop-after', 'working-tabs-drop-into');
		this.dropMarkedEl = null;
	}

	private async handleDrop(dragged: SpaceNode, target: SpaceNode, position: DropPosition): Promise<void> {
		if (dragged.type === 'tab') {
			if (position === 'into' && target.type === 'section') {
				await this.plugin.leafSync.sendToPool([dragged], target.id);
				return;
			}
			if (position === 'into' && target.type === 'group') {
				await this.plugin.leafSync.sendToGroup([dragged], target.id);
				return;
			}
			if (target.type !== 'tab' || !target.parentId) return;
			const parent = this.store.find(target.parentId);
			const siblings = this.store.children(target.parentId).filter((n) => n.id !== dragged.id);
			let index = siblings.findIndex((n) => n.id === target.id);
			if (index === -1) index = siblings.length;
			if (position === 'after') index += 1;
			if (parent?.type === 'section') {
				await this.store.moveInto(dragged.id, parent.id, index);
				return;
			}
			if (parent?.type === 'group') await this.plugin.leafSync.sendToGroup([dragged], parent.id, index);
			return;
		}

		if (position === 'into') {
			const index = this.store.children(target.id).filter((n) => n.id !== dragged.id).length;
			await this.store.moveInto(dragged.id, target.id, index);
			return;
		}
		const siblings = this.store.children(target.parentId).filter((n) => n.id !== dragged.id);
		let index = siblings.findIndex((n) => n.id === target.id);
		if (index === -1) index = siblings.length;
		if (position === 'after') index += 1;
		await this.store.moveInto(dragged.id, target.parentId, index);
	}

	private registerRootDropZone(treeEl: HTMLElement): void {
		treeEl.addEventListener('dragover', (evt) => {
			if (evt.target !== treeEl || !this.draggedId) return;
			const dragged = this.store.find(this.draggedId);
			if (dragged && this.canDropAt(dragged, null)) evt.preventDefault();
		});
		treeEl.addEventListener('drop', (evt) => {
			if (evt.target !== treeEl || !this.draggedId) return;
			const dragged = this.store.find(this.draggedId);
			if (!dragged || !this.canDropAt(dragged, null)) return;
			evt.preventDefault();
			const index = this.store.children(null).filter((n) => n.id !== this.draggedId).length;
			void this.store.moveInto(this.draggedId, null, index);
		});
	}

	private registerSentinelDropZone(headerEl: HTMLElement, sentinelId: string): void {
		headerEl.addEventListener('dragover', (evt) => {
			if (!this.draggedId) return;
			const dragged = this.store.find(this.draggedId);
			if (dragged && this.canDropAt(dragged, sentinelId)) evt.preventDefault();
		});
		headerEl.addEventListener('drop', (evt) => {
			if (!this.draggedId) return;
			const dragged = this.store.find(this.draggedId);
			if (!dragged || !this.canDropAt(dragged, sentinelId)) return;
			evt.preventDefault();
			if (sentinelId === COMPLETED_PARENT_ID && dragged.type === 'group') {
				this.requestComplete(dragged);
				return;
			}
			void this.store.moveInto(this.draggedId, sentinelId, this.store.children(sentinelId).length);
		});
	}
}
```

```
/** Terminal views serialise their scrollback inside view state. Their identity is the view type plus leaf id, which does not need that read. Every other view may store a file path in view state. */
const SKIP_VIEW_STATE_TYPES = new Set(['terminus-view', 'terminus-diff-split']);

export function needsViewStateForIdentity(viewType: string, directFilePath: string | undefined): boolean {
	if (directFilePath) return false;
	return !SKIP_VIEW_STATE_TYPES.has(viewType);
}

```

```
import { needsViewStateForIdentity } from './tab-identity';

describe('needsViewStateForIdentity', () => {
	it('skips view state when the leaf already has a file', () => {
		expect(needsViewStateForIdentity('markdown', 'notes/a.md')).toBe(false);
	});

	it('skips view state for a live terminal', () => {
		expect(needsViewStateForIdentity('terminus-view', undefined)).toBe(false);
		expect(needsViewStateForIdentity('terminus-diff-split', undefined)).toBe(false);
```
